sa: वर्तमानेषु सवत्तिं पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु॥ प्रीतिमानभवद् राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः।
en: Seeing that the great Pandavas were in the observance of a wise and righteous conduct, king Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, became pleased with them.

sa: तेजसाऽऽदित्यसदृशः क्षमया पृथिवीसमः। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या हिमवानिव सुस्थिरः॥
en: And in energy he resembled the sun and in patience, Earth herself; in intelligence, he was like Brihaspati, and in calmness the mountain Himavan himself.

sa: ततस्तु निधनं प्राप्तः कालपर्यायचोदितः। ततो जायति मानुषः॥
en: Actuated by the change that is occasioned by time, he then renounces that form and, his sin having been exhausted, he regains the human form.

sa: पराक्रमैस्तेऽपि तदा व्यनन्नत्रिसुरक्षिताः। उद्भासितश्च सविता देवास्त्राता हतासुराः॥
en: Displaying his prowess and collecting all his energy, it was thus that Atri illumined the god of day, rescued the celestials, and killed the Asuras.

sa: दुर्गाण्यतितरत्याशु पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमम्। स्तुवन् नामसहस्रेण नित्यं भक्तिसमन्वितः॥
en: The man who sings the praises of that foremost of Beings by reciting His thousand names with devotion succeeds in speedily getting over all difficulties.

sa: धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च त्रितयं जीविते फलम्॥ एतत् त्रयमवाप्तव्ययधर्मपरिवर्जितम्।
en: Virtue, wealth, and pleasure, these three form the fruit of life. Onc should win these three by means of being free from impropriety and sin.

sa: प्रचोद्यमानः स गजस्तेन राज्ञा महाबलः। तदाकडुशेन विबभावुत्पतिष्यन्निवाम्बरम्॥
en: Urged on by the prince with the iron-hook, that powerful elephant then scemed as if it would cut through the sky (like a flying hill).

sa: तत्रैनं पर्युपातिष्ठन् ब्राह्मणा वनवासिनः। क्षत्रविट्शूद्रसंघाश्च बहवो भरतर्षभ।॥
en: There many Brahmanas who had taken up their residence in the forest, as also many Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras, came to see the old king.

sa: स्कन्द उवाच ममाप्यनुमतो धर्मस्तं शृणुध्वं समाहिताः। नीलपण्डस्य श्रृंगाभ्यां मृत्तिकां तु यः॥ अभिषेकं त्र्यहं कुर्यात् तस्य धर्म निबोधता शोधयेदशुभं सर्वमाधिपत्यं परत्र च॥
en: Skanda said I shall now describe a duty that is approved of by me. Do ye listen to it with rapt attention. That person who takes a little earth from the horns of a bull of blue color, smears his body therewith for three days, and them performs his ablutions, wins great merits. Hear what those merits are. By such a deed he would wash away every stain and evil, and acquire sovereign sway hereafter.

sa: शरीरभृद् गार्हपत्यस्तस्मादन्यः प्रणीयते। मनचाहवनीयस्तु तस्मिन् प्रक्षिप्यते हविः॥
en: The bearer of the body is the Garhapatya fire. From that is produced another. Mind is the Ahavaniya fire. Into it is, poured the oblation.

sa: चामरव्यजने शुभ्रे भीमसेनार्जुनावुभौ॥ उष्णीषे परिगृहीतां माद्रीपुत्रावुभौ तथा।
en: Bhimasena and Arjuna both held in their hands a couple of pure white yaktails. The two sons of Madri held two headgears in their hands.

sa: तत एनमुपाजग्मुरमात्याः सपुरोहिताः। बलस्था गणिकायुक्ताः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा॥
en: The counsellors then, with the priest, came out to welcome him. His troops also and the dancing women and all his subjects, did the same.

sa: बृहस्पति उवाच मरुत्तमाहुर्मघवन् यक्ष्यमाणं महायज्ञेनोत्तमदक्षिणेन। संवर्तो याजयतीति मे श्रुतं तदिच्छामि न स तं याजयेत॥
en: O Indra, I have heard that Marutta will celebrate a great sacrifice at which rich presents will be given by him (to Brahmanas) and that at his sacrifice Samvarta will act as the officiating priest, and, therefore, do I wish that he may not officiate as priest at that sacrifice.

sa: तासां संक्रीडमानानामेष वादिनि:स्वनः। श्रूयते भूषणोन्मिश्रो गीतशब्दो मनोहरः॥
en: As your sport, we hear the sounds of their musical instruments, and the sweet voice of their song mixed with the tinkling of their instruments.

sa: तं जाग्रतं गुणैर्युक्तं वरचापेषु धारिणम्। भ्रातृगुप्त्यर्थमत्यन्तमहं लक्ष्मणमब्रुवम्॥
en: To Lakşmaņa crowned with every virtue, waking up, holding the bow with the arrow fixed on it for the purpose of guarding well his brother.

sa: संचितान्यस्य वित्तानि विविधानि सहस्रशः। दस्युभिर्विप्रलुप्यन्तां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile of the noble one into the woods, have his various accumulated riches by thousand carried off by robbers!

sa: सुग्रीवोऽप्यनदद् घोरं वालिनो ह्वानकारणात्। गाढं परिहितो वेगानादर्भिन्दनिवाम्बरम्॥
en: With a view to call Vāli, Sugrīva, tying fast his cloth (around the waist) set up a terrible roar, as if rending the sky (therewith).

sa: शिरस्येकेन बाणेन द्वाभ्यां बाह्वोरथार्पयत्। त्रिभिश्चन्द्रार्धवक्त्रैश्च वक्षस्यभिजघान ह॥
en: And with one shaft he pierced Khara's head, with two his arms, and with three arrows headed like half-moons, Rāma wounded Khara in the chest.

sa: पन्नगासुरगन्धर्वदेवदानवराक्षसैः॥ अशक्यस्तव वैदेहि भर्ता जेतुं न संशयः।
en: O Vaidehi, celestials, Dānavas, Gandharabas, Raksasas, Asuras, or Pannagas, there is none who can defeat your husband. There is not the least doubt in this.

sa: आनयेगुदिपिण्याकं चीरमाहर चोत्तरम्। जलक्रियार्थं तातस्य गमिष्यामि महात्मनः॥
en: Do you bring Ingudi fruits as well as a piece of new bark. I will go to perform the watery rites of our high-souled sire.

sa: केनायमुपदिष्टस्ते विनाशः पापकर्मणा। सपुत्रस्य सराज्यस्य सामात्यस्य निशाचर॥
en: What person of impious deeds has advised you ( ranger of the night thus in order to exterminate you with your kingdom, counsellors and children?

sa: तस्माज्ज्येष्ठे हि कैकैयि राज्यतन्त्राणि पार्थिवाः। स्थापयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गि गुणवत्स्वितरेष्वपि॥
en: Therefore it is that kings, O Kaikeyi, lay the task of Government on the eldest son if worthy, or else upon a younger most meritorious.

sa: मा त्वं प्रोत्साहिता पापैर्देवराजसमप्रभम्। भर्तारं लोकभर्तारमसद्धर्ममुपादघ ॥
en: Do not incited by evil propensities, make your husband, the lord of men endued with the prowess of the celestial chief, perpetrate an unrighteous deed.

sa: नहि लोकविरुद्धस्य लोकवृत्तादपेयुषः। दण्डादन्यत्र पश्यामि निग्रहं हरियूथप॥
en: o you, the leader of monkey-herds-I find no other alternative than to punish him who act against humanity and violates the sacred sanctions of custom.

sa: असक्नुवन्निष्कमितुं महिषो विनशिष्यति। ततोऽहमागां किष्किन्धां निराशस्तस्य जीविते॥
en: (And thought I), 'Mahisa, unable to issue out, needs must meet his end.' And despairing of his (Vali's) life, I retraced my steps to Kiskindha.

sa: तत्र तापसमासीनं मलपङ्कजधारिणम्। रामः सुतीक्ष्णं विधिवत् तपोधनमभाषत॥
en: There Rāma duly addressed an ascetic seated in the lotus-attitude* for warding off evil, even Sutīksna, *The yoya system has many positions for concentrating thought.

sa: पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चापि लम्बमानास्तदुन्मुखाः। बाष्पपूर्णमुखाः सर्वे तमूचु शनिःस्वनाः॥
en: As his side and back, the people bending forward with their faces covered with the vapour of grief, and sighing hard, said to he charioteer.

sa: सहसाचरितां स्थानान्महीं पुण्यक्षयाद् गताम्। संहृतद्युतिविस्तारां तारामिव दिवश्च्युताम्॥
en: Like a star on the expiration of its virtue, moving from its place and dislodged from heaven, dropping to the earth with its brightness contracted.

sa: ततस्तेऽञ्जनसंकाशा गिरेस्तस्मान्महाबलाः। तिस्रः कोट्यः प्लवङ्गानां निर्ययुर्यत्र राघवः॥
en: And monkeys resembling collyrium (in hue), numbering three kotis, endued with huge might, set out from the Añjana hill for the place where Rāghava was.

sa: अतिक्रान्तमतिक्रान्तमनवाप्य मनोरथम्। राज्ये राममनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति॥
en: Saying, All is lost, All is lost, with his desire unattained, my father having failed to install Rāma in the kingdom, will resign his existence.

sa: तं वै रुचिरदन्तोष्ठं रूप्यधातुतनूरुहम्॥ विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना सस्नेहं समुदैक्षत।
en: It had beautiful teeth and lips and had its down resembling silver. She began to behold with affection and with her eyes expanded with surprise.

sa: अभिज्ञानप्रदानं च सीतायाश्चापि भाषणम्। राक्षसीतर्जनं चैव त्रिजटास्वप्नदर्शनम्॥
en: His presentation of the ring to Sītā and converse with her; and the roaring of the Rākṣasis; and the dreaming of the dream by Trijatā.

sa: मीनोपसंदर्शितमेखलानां नदीवधूनां गतयोऽद्य मन्दाः। कान्तोपभुक्तालसगामिनीनां प्रभातकालेष्विव कामिनीनाम्॥
en: The rivers, having fishes for their girdles, have become of slackened course like to damsels moving slowly in the dawn being enjoyed by their husbands.

sa: भूधरांस्तत्र विश्वात्मा शम्भुरेकादशात्मकः। ब्रह्मा वसति देवेशो ब्रह्मर्षिपरिवारितः॥
en: There that Soul of the Universe, the adorable Sambhu, fraught with the spirits of the eleven Rudras-that lord of the gods-Brahmā.dwelleth, surrounded by the Brahmarsis.

sa: न्यस्यतां कलशस्तात दीयतां वल्कलं मम। इदमेवावगाहिष्ये तमसातीर्थमुत्तमम्॥
en: O child, do you, put down your pitcher, and give me my bark. I will bathe even in this Tamasā, the best of holy spots.

sa: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वांल्लोकान् महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने॥
en: O mighty anchorite, I shall acquire all those regions myself. I now wish that you may direct me as to my abode in this forest.

sa: प्रत्यगारमिवायान्ती सवत्सा वत्सकारणात्। बद्धवत्सा यथा धेनू राममाताभ्यधावत।॥
en: Rāma's mother rushed after him like a cow having a calf which has been fettered, rushing towards the fold, for the purpose of seeing it.

sa: लङ्कायाः सुमहद्राज्यमिदं त्वमनुपालय। त्वत्प्रेष्या मद्विधाश्चैव देवाश्चापि चराचरम्॥
en: Do you govern at Lankā this extensive kingdom. The like of me and celestials and all that are mobile and immobile shall be your servants.

sa: त्वमिहासुरसङ्घानां देवराज्ञा महात्मना। पातालनिलयानां हि परिघः संनिवेशितः॥
en: O lord, you had been placed here by the king of celestials as an outer gate against the Asuras inhabiting the region under the earth.

sa: जनौधैस्तैर्विसर्पद्भिः शुश्रुवे तत्र नि:स्वनः। पर्वसूदीर्णवेगस्य सागरस्येव निःस्वनः॥
en: As the vast concourse entered (the city),there was heard an uproar like to the roaring of the heaving ocean during the fullness of the moon.

sa: वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभमिन्द्रो वालिनमात्मजम्। सुग्रीवं जनयामास तपनस्तपतां वरः॥
en: And Indra beget as his son that foremost of monkeys, Vāli, resembling the Mahendra hill, and that best of those imparting heat, the Sun, Sugriva.

sa: तस्याभ्याशे तु मिथुनं चरन्तमनपायिनम्। ददर्श भगवांस्तत्र क्रौञ्चयोश्चारुनिःस्वनम्॥
en: In the vicinity of the forest, that worshipful one espied a pair of Krauñcas, emitting melodious notes, and ranging around never parting from one another.

sa: यदर्थमयमारम्भः कृतः परपुरञ्जय। समयं नाभिजानाति कृतार्थः प्लवगेश्वरः॥
en: O conqueror of enemies' cities, does not that lord of monkeys, after accomplishing his object, think of the conditions under which our friendship was contracted?

sa: तदेतद् धनुषां श्रेष्ठमानीतं मुनिपुङ्गव। दर्शयैतन्महाभाग अनयो राजपुत्रयोः॥
en: This foremost of bows has been brought here, O chief of ascetics. Do you, O exalted one, show it to these sons of the king.

sa: अमात्यानुपधातीतान् पितृपैतामहाशुचीन्। श्रेष्ठाञ्छेष्ठेषु कच्चित् त्वं नियोजयसि कर्मसु॥
en: And did you employ upon the most worthy offices counsellors who are above bribery, who have served your father and grand-father, and who are pure?

sa: तदतिक्रम्य काकुत्स्थ वनं पुष्पितपादपम्॥ नन्दनप्रतिमं त्वन्यत् कुरवस्तूत्तरा इव। सर्वकालफला यत्र पादपा मधुरस्रवाः॥ सर्वे च ऋतवस्तत्र वने चैत्ररथे यथा। फलभारनतास्तत्र महाविटपधारिणः।।८ शोभन्ते सर्वतस्तत्र मेघपर्वतसंनिभाः। तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वाथवा सुखम्॥ फलान्यमृतकल्पानि लक्ष्मणस्ते प्रदास्यति।
en: Passing by this forest, O Kākutstha, you shall reach another abounding in trees blooming with flowers like to the garden of celestials and Uttarkuru where in all the months of the year the trees produce fruits and honey and where all the seasons dwell as in the forest of Chaitraratha*. There stand beautifully many a tree lowered down with the burden of fruits, containing towering branches, dense as a collection of clouds or a mountain. Ascending those trees and lowering them, Lakşmaņa shall offer you, fruits like to ambrosia. The garden of the deity Kuvera. It is derived from Caitraratha a Gandharva in charge of the garden.

sa: तस्यास्त्रं गाधिपुत्रस्य घोरमाग्नेयमुत्तमम्। ब्रह्मदण्डेन तच्छान्तमग्नेर्वेग इवाम्भसा ॥
en: And even as water ally the fierceness of a flame, the Brahmā staff quenched the energy of the powerful fiery weapon discharged by Gadhi's Son.

sa: स भीमकार्मुकशरः कृष्णाञ्जनचयोपमः। रक्तास्यनयनो भीमो बभौ मृत्युरिवान्तकः॥
en: Accoutred in a dreadful bow and arrows, that one, resembling a mass of collyrium, having a red face and eyes, looked dreadful like the reaper-death.

sa: ततो दूरात्प्रददृशे धनाध्यक्षो गदाधरः। शुक्रप्रौष्द्वपदाभ्यां च पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः॥
en: Then at a distance, the lord of riches, mace in hand, accompanied by Sukra and Praushthapada and Padma and Sanka saw (Ravana) in the field.

sa: अलब्धवरपूर्णेन यत्कृतं राक्षसेन तु॥ यद्येष वरलब्धः स्याद्भक्षयेद्भुवनत्रयम्।
en: Considering what this Rākşasa did when he had not obtained any boon whatever, if he obtain one now, he shall eat up the three worlds.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पितामहसमीरितम्। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विभावसुः॥
en: Hearing those excellent words uttered by the great Patriarch rose up Vibhāvasu (The deity of Fire) with Vaidehi on his lap shaking the funeral pyre.

sa: शरैरुष्टैर्हयैर्दीप्तैः शिशुमारैर्महोरगैः॥ राक्षसाः प्रययुः सर्वे कृत्वाकाशं निरन्तरम्।
en: All the Rākşasas went covering the sky, some on asses, some on camels, some on horses, some on quick-coursing porpoises and some on huge serpents.

sa: सीतायास्तेजता दग्धां रामकोपप्रदीपिताम्। दह्यमानामिमां पश्य पुरीं साट्टप्रतोलिकाम्॥
en: You shall behold this city crowned with edifices and stalls, in flames fed by the wrath of Rāma, and consumed by the energy of Şītā.

sa: कुमुदाङ्गदयोर्वापि सुषेणस्य महाकपेः। प्रसिद्धेयं भवेत् भूमिमॆन्दद्विविदयोरपि॥ विवस्वतस्तनूजस्य हरेश्च कुशपर्वणः। ऋक्षस्य कपिमुख्यस्य मम चैव गतिर्भवेत्॥
en: This place can be easily entered by Kumuda, and Angada, as well as by that mighty monkey, Suşeņa; and also by Mainda and Dvivida. And there is way also for the offspring of the Sun, and that monkey, Kuśaparva, as well as of that foremost of monkeys, Rksya, and myself."

sa: रामं दृष्ट्वा सुसंक्रुद्धमुत्पाताश्चैव दारुणान्। वित्रेसुः सर्वभूतानि रावणस्याभवद्भयम्।॥
en: Seeing Rāma wrought up with a mighty passion, and the fearful disastrous omens, all creatures were possessed by fright and Rāvana was stuck with dismay.

sa: तथा स्म तेषां वसतामृक्षवानररक्षसाम्। राघवस्तु महातेजाः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: In this wise, the monkeys, bears and Rākşasas spent their days in Ayodhyä. Thereupon the highly effulgent Rāma, the descendant of Raghu said to Sugrīva.

sa: त्रिदशपतिं परिगृह्य रावणिः। स्वभवनमधिगम्य वीर्यवान् कृतसमरान्विससर्ज राक्षसान्॥
en: Thereupon having returned home with his army and chariots and taking the king of the celestials, the powerful son of Rāvana dismissed the victorious warriors.

sa: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशः कोऽप्यसौ राक्षसेश्वर। नर्मदां रोधवद्ध्वा क्रीडापयति योषितः॥
en: O lord of Rākşasas, an unknown person, huge as a Sāla tree, is sporting with females obstructing the course of Narmadā like to a dam.

sa: देवि हर्युक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्त्वदर्थे कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: O worshipful dame, Sugrīva, the foremost of the monkeys, the lord of monkey and bear hosts and gifted with manliness, has resolved upon rescuing you.

sa: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते। प्रीतिसंजननं भूयस्तस्य त्वं दातुमर्हसि॥
en: Now, O faultless lady, you ought to give me such a sign as Rāma shall certainly recognise, and as shall more please him by far.

sa: नित्यं श्रेयसि सम्मूढं महद्भिर्व्यसनैर्वृतम्। हन्यात्कस्तादृशं लोकं जराव्याधिशतैर्युतम्॥
en: Who should slay creatures, who are ever stupid in respect of their welfare, environed by mighty dangers, and encompassed by hundreds of decrepitude and decease?

sa: अपश्यद् राक्षसपतिं हनूमानतितेजसम्। वेष्टितं मेरुशिखरे सतोयमिव तोयदम्॥
en: Hanumān beheld the immensely energetic lord of Rākşasas surrounded (on all sides by his advisers), like a cloud containing water on a summit of Meru.

sa: उद्योजययिष्यनुद्योगं दधे लङ्कावधे मनः। जिघांसुरिव लोकान्ते सँल्लिोकान्विभावसुः॥
en: And exciting (his soldiers) for making preparations like to Fire about to destroy all people he made up his mind for the devastation of Lanka.

sa: संग्रामे सुमहद्व्यूहे तर्पयित्वा हुताशनम्। अन्तर्धानगतः श्रीमानिन्द्रजिद्धन्ति राघव॥
en: And, worshipping Fire and becoming invisible, Indrajit, that graceful hero, O Raghava, slays the enemies in conflict, having the contending parties vast and well arranged.

sa: प्राणिनो मोक्षितास्तेन दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा॥ सुखमापुर्मुहूर्त ते ह्यतर्कितमचिन्तितम्। प्रेतेषु मुच्यमानेषु राक्षसेन महीयसा॥ प्रेतगोपाः सुसंक्रुद्धा राक्षसेन्द्रमभिद्रवन्।
en: On being liberated by that Rākṣasa the tennecked one, those creatures in a moment began to enjoy their release, that had come to them without thought or suspense. And on the dead being delivered by the magnanimous Rākşasa, the guards of the dead, getting enraged, rushed at the Rākşasa sovereign.

sa: तच्छुत्वा वचनं तेषां राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः। चिन्तारोषसमाक्रान्तो विवर्णवदनोऽभवत्॥
en: Hearing those words of theirs, the exceedingly powerful lord of the Raksasas was wrought up with anxiety and anger, and his countenance lost its complexion.

sa: हनूमता कीर्तिमता यशस्विना तथाङ्गदेनाङ्गदनद्धबाहुना। न्महीधराग्रं ज्वलितं श्रियाभवत्॥
en: When the famous and renowned Hanumān, and Angada with bracelets on his arms, had sat down, the elevated and mighty mountain-summit was illuminated with splendour.

sa: ते तान्सर्वाशराजघ्नुः सर्परूपान्महाजवान्। सुपर्णरूपा रामस्य विशिखा: कामरूपिणः॥
en: The shafts of Rāma capable of wearing forms at will, turned into birds, destroyed all the exceedingly swift coursing arrows having the forms of serpents.

sa: तेषां संजल्पमानानामशोकवनिकां गताम्। अभिदुद्राव वैदेहीं रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: As they were speaking thus, Ravana, reft of his senses by wrath, rushed against Vaidehi, who had taken up her abode in the Asoka wood.

sa: घण्टानामिव संनादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वनः। अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये॥
en: There was audible in the house of the lord of riches, the sweet music of the assembled Apsarās like to the sound of the bell.

sa: राजसंश्रयवश्यानां कुर्वतीनां पराज्ञया॥ विधेयानां च दासीनां कः कुप्येद्वानरोत्तम। भाग्यवैषम्यदोषेण पुरस्ताद्दुष्कृतेन च ॥ मयैतत्प्राप्यते सर्व स्वकृतं ह्युपभुज्यते मैवं वद महाबाहो दैवी ह्येषा परा गतिः॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, why are you angry with these she-slaves, who subject as they are to the command of their lord, have done this in accordance with another's order. I or my adverse fortune and vicious deeds perpetrated in another birth I have been subject to such a plight and been suffering the consequence thereof. Do yon not speak thus, O you of huge arms. Such is the course of Fortune. Forsooth by my ill-luck I have met with (this misfortune).

sa: त्वमस्मिन् कार्यनिर्वाहे प्रमाणं हरियूथप। राघस्त्वत्समारम्भान्मयि यत्नपरो भवेत्॥
en: O leader of monkey-bands, do you bring about success on this undertaking. From this preliminary endeavour of yours, Rāghava shall take pains on my behalf.

sa: अन्ये सुनिशितैः शस्त्रैराकाशे संजघट्टिरे। बभञ्जश्चिच्छिदुश्चैव तयोर्बाणाः सहस्रशः॥
en: And other shafts were resisted in the sky by sharpened weapons, and some were snapped, and thousands of their arrows were cleft (in the sky).

sa: पुष्पावकीर्णः शुशुभे हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। अशोकवनिकामध्ये यथा पुष्पमयो गिरिः॥
en: And in the midst of the Asoka wood, Hanumān, son to the Wind-god, covered over with flowers, looked lovely like a hill strewn with blossoms.

sa: शैलैः शूलैश्च खङ्गैश्च विमुक्तैः कपिराक्षसैः। भविष्यत्यावृता भूमिमा॑सशोणितकर्दमा॥
en: The earth shall be covered with darts and javelins, and swords discharged by monkeys and Räkşasas, and be turned into mire with flesh and gore.

sa: ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीव्र वज्रनिष्पेषनिष्ठुरम्। गिरा गम्भीरया रामो राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाच ह॥
en: He sharply twanged his bow-string sounding like the terrific crash of thunder, and then in solemn tones, Rāma addressed the lord of Răks asas, Saying.

sa: अद्य वानरसैन्यानि रथेन पवनौजसा। धनुःसमुद्रादुद्भूतैर्मथिष्यामि शरोमिभिः ॥
en: Ascending my car gifted with the velocity of the wind shall I churn today the monkey host with arrow-like waves coming from the oceanlike bow.

sa: आक्षिप्ताः क्षिप्यमाणाश्च भग्नशैलैश्च वानरैः। पुनरङ्गैस्तदा चक्रुर्वानरा युद्धमद्भुतम्॥
en: The monkeys thrown down and felled by means of broken crags and monkeys* and arms and legs, waged a wonderful war. *i.e. the carcasses thereof.

sa: जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा सुपुङ्ख हेमभूषितम्। तेजसा सर्वभूतानां कृतं भास्करवर्चसम्।७।। सधूममिव कालाग्नि दीप्तमाशीविषोपमम्। नरनागाश्ववृन्दानां भेदनं क्षिप्रकारिणम्॥
en: It is resplendent by its own lustre, well feathered and adorned with gold-made of the essence of all objects and bright as the rays of the Sun. It is like the fire of dissolution enveloped in smoke-like the flaming serpent, capable of piercing men, serpents and horses and was swift-coursing.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानमाशीविषविषोपमैः। विव्याधोरसि सौमित्री रावणिं पञ्चभिः शरैः॥
en: When (Indrajit) had his bow severed, Suinitra's son pierced the son of Rāvana with five shafts resembling the venom of a poisonous serpent. piercing his?

sa: ततस्तु तां पुरीं लङ्कां रम्यामभिययौ कपिः। हसितोत्कृष्टनिनदैस्तूर्यघोषपुरस्कृतैः॥ वज्राङ्कुशनिकाशैश्च वज्रजालविभूषतैः। गृहमेधैः पुरी रम्या बभासे द्यौरिवाम्बुदैः॥
en: The monkey held his way in the charming city of Lankā, resounding with grateful sounds mixed with laughter, and ringing with trumpet blasts. And with multitudes of mansions marked with the thunderbolt and the hook, and adorned with diamond windows, the charming metropolis looked splendid, like the welkin with clouds.

sa: धनुः शक्रधनुःप्रख्यं महद् रुचिरसायकम्। विस्फारयाणो वेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्॥
en: He impetuously stretched a graceful bow, resembling the bow of Sakra, and roaring like vajra and the thounderbolt. (For distinction between the two, vide ante).

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु यज्ञमिष्ट्वा च वैष्णवम्॥ पुनस्त्रिदिवमाक्रामदन्वशासच्च देवराट्।
en: Hearing this and having celebrated the sacrifice in honour of Vişnu he again went to the region of celestials and reigned there as their king.

sa: ततस्त्वन्नाशजं शोकं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥ लक्ष्मणो वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयत्।
en: Thereupon Lakşmaņa related to Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, the grief, of Rāma of unwearied actions, in consequence of your being borne away (by Rāvana).

sa: उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशो रथे सुसमलंकृते। कालाश्वयुक्ते महति स्थितः कालान्तकोपमः॥
en: With upraised weapons and scimitars, he, resembling the Destroyer himself, was mounted on a mighty car yoked with black steeds, and ornamented (on all sides).

sa: स महामेघसंकाशं समीक्ष्यात्मानमात्मवान्। निरुन्धन्तमिवाकाशं चकार मतिमान् मतिम्॥
en: Surveying his own person resembling a mighty mass of clouds, and as if closing up the sky, that self-possessed one ascertained his course of action.

sa: निश्चितार्थस्ततः साम्ना पूज्यं शत्रुजिदग्रजम्। उवाच हितमत्यर्थं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।४।। क्षमस्व रोषं त्यज राक्षसेन्द्र प्रसीद मे वाक्यमिदं शृणुष्व। वधं न कुर्वन्ति परावरज्ञा दूतस्य सन्तो वसुधाधिपेन्द्राः॥
en: Having arrived at a decision, that one skilled in speech, paying homage to that conqueror of foes, his elder brother, spoke to him in words eminently good. “O lord of Rākṣasas, forgive me and renounce your wrath." (The commentator says, the passage means, ‘Give up your promise (to slay Hanumãn) and abate your anger.) Extend your favour to me, and hear these words of mine. Lords of the earth, endowed with integrity and knowing high and low, never put messengers to death,

sa: अस्वस्थनरनारीकमिदं वृष्णिकुलं भृशम्। किमिदं नरशार्दूल श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: "O best of men, why are the men and the women of the Vrishni race are all woc-begone. I desire to hear all about it."

sa: कथं नु सत्यः शुचिरार्यवृत्तो ज्येष्ठः सुतानां मम धर्मराजः। अजातशत्रुः पृथिवीतले स्म शेते पुरा राङ्कवकूटशायी॥
en: "Alas, how is it that Dharmaraja Yudhishthira who is the eldest of my sons, who is truthful and pious and virtuous in his behaviour, who has not a single enemy (on earth) and who formerly used to sleep on beds made of soft Ranku-skins, sleeps now on the bare ground!

sa: महाभिजनसम्पन्नं भद्रे महति संस्थितम्। पाण्डवास्त्वाभिवीक्षन्तां ययातिमिव नाहुषम्॥
en: Let the Pandavas see you like Yayati, the son of Nahusha accompanied by a large number of followers and in the enjoyment of great bliss.

sa: तथालोकान्तकृच्छ्रीमान् यमः साक्षात् प्रतापवान् मर्त्यमूर्तिधरैः सार्धं पितृभिर्लोकभावनैः॥
en: As also (came) the graceful and powerful Yama, the destroyer of the worlds accompanied by the lords of creations, the manes, both embodied and disembodied.

sa: प्रीतिमन्त उपातिष्ठन्नभिषेकं महर्षयः। जामदग्न्येन सहितास्तथान्ये वेदपारगाः॥ अभिजग्मुर्महात्मानो मन्त्रवद् भूरिदक्षिणम्। महेन्द्रमिव देवेन्द्रं दिवि सप्तर्षयो यथा॥
en: The great Rishis sat with cheerful heart at the place where the sprinkling ceremony took place. As the seven Rishis approached the chief of the celestials Indra in heaven, so the illustrious Rishis, learned in the Vedas, with the son of Jamadagni, came uttering Mantras to the great Dakshina-giving (Yudhishthira).

sa: ततो धुन्धुर्महाराज दिशमावृत्य पश्चिमाम्॥ सुप्तोऽभूद् राजशार्दूल कालानलसमद्युतिः।
en: Thereupon O great monarch, Dhundhu lay asleep, occupying the whole of the western point of the horizon; and he looked effulgent like the all-destroying fire.

sa: केकयाश्चाप्यनुज्ञाताः कौन्तेयेनामितौजसा। आमन्त्र्य पाण्डवान् सर्वान् प्रययुस्तेऽपि भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the Kaikeyas also, with the permission of Kunti's immeasurably energetic son (Yudhishthira) and having reverentially saluted all the Pandavas. went away.

sa: व्रतप्रतिनिधिश्चैव तस्मिन् काले प्रवर्तते। ब्राह्मणाः शूद्रकर्माणस्तथा शूद्राधनार्जकाः॥
en: Vows observed by representatives are also introduced. The Brahmanas perform acts that should be performed by the Shudras and the Shudras take to earn wealth.

sa: रुक्मपृष्ठंधनुर्गृह्य शरांश्चाशीविषोपमान्। मृगराडिव संक्रुद्धः प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः॥
en: Taking the bow in laid with gold and also arrows resembling poisonous snakes, he proceeded like a lion in rage or an elephant in rut.

sa: चरितब्रह्मचर्याश्च क्रोधामर्षवशानुगाः। वैरं निर्यातयिष्यन्ति महद् दुःखाय पाण्डवाः॥
en: Practising Brahmacharya. The Pandavas will to our great grief return in anger (at the end of the thirteenth) to take great ngeanceve on their foes.

sa: इत्येवमुक्ते वचनेधृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः। प्रसादयामास मुनि नैतदेवं भवेदिति॥
en: When the Rishi had thus spoken, the ruler of earth, Dhritarashtra, began to gratify the Rishi, so that what he had said may not happen.

sa: विनदन्तं महानादं भिन्नभेरीस्वनं बली। भ्रामयामास सुचिरं विस्फुरन्तमचेतसम्॥
en: The monster then roared fearfully like a trumpet out of order. But the hero (Bhima) whirled him for a long time, till he became insensible.

sa: कृतमङ्गलकल्याणो भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः। गतेषु क्षत्रियेन्द्रेषु सर्वेषु भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, on the departure of all the Kshatriya kings, he (Yudhishthira), surrounded by his brothers, performed the usual auspicious rites.

sa: योपकर्तश्च हर्तश्च तेजसैवोपगच्छति। तस्मादुद्विजते लोकः सर्पाद् वेश्मगतादिव॥
en: People are afraid of him who abuses his power equally upon his benefactor and enemy, as the inmates of a house are of a snake.

sa: नानामृगगणैर्जुष्टं कौन्तेयः सत्यविक्रमः। पदातिर्धातृभिः सार्धं प्रातिष्ठत युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Then Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti possessed of true prowess, began to proceed on foot along the mountain path inhabited by various kinds of beasts.

sa: हिमवांश्च सुदुर्गोऽयं यक्षराक्षससंकुलः। मां समुद्रीक्षमाणास्ते प्रपतिष्यन्ति विह्वलाः॥
en: This Himalayan (mountain) is inaccessible and full of the Yakshas and the Rakshasas. Here looking about for me they will be dejected and crest fallen.

sa: अधर्मो यत्रधर्माख्योधर्मश्चाधर्मसंज्ञितः। स विज्ञेयो विभागेन यत्र मुह्यन्त्यबुद्धयः॥
en: One should ascertain with discrimination those cases in which vice goes under the name of virtue and in which men, having no intelligence, become perplexed.

sa: राजानमागतं श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंजहषुः प्रजाः। ततोऽङ्गपतिराहूय सचिवान् मन्त्रकोविदान्॥
en: Having heard of the arrival of the being, the subjects became exceedingly glad. Then the ruler of Anga summoned his ministers, proficient in giving counsel.

sa: गते पितामह राजा चिन्ताशोकसमन्वितः। निःश्वसन्नुष्णमसकृत् तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्॥
en: On the departure of the grandfather (Vyasa), the king became afflicted with grief and anxiety. He continuously sighed and reflected on what the Rishi said.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेयमपोह्य वसनं स्वकम्। स्मयन्नवेक्ष्य पाञ्चालीमैश्वर्यमदमोहितः॥
en: "O king, Bhima, Arjuna, and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) are ever under your seat. Answer this question. Say whether you regard Krishna as won".

sa: शमेन धर्मेण नयेन युक्ता या ते बुद्धिः सास्तु ते मा प्रमादीः। {दुप्रौढा गच्छति पुत्रपौत्रान्॥
en: Let your mind, guided by counsels of peace, virtue and true policy, be what it naturally is. Do not err. The prosperity which is acquired by the aid of wicked acts is soon destroyed, while that which is won by honest means takes root and descends from generation to generation.

sa: तदवस्थान् सुतान् सर्वानुपसृत्यातिवत्सला। स्वजमानावदच्छोकात् तत्तद् विलपती बहु॥
en: Kunti, possessing excess of parental affection, approached her sons who were in that state. Embracing them all, she spoke thus her voice choked with grief.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गच्छेत भरतर्षभ। धारां नाम महाप्राज्ञः सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O greatly wise one, walking round it, one should, go to the Tirtha called Dhara which destroys all sins.

sa: अथ दुर्योधनो राजा शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥ दुःशासनो विकर्णश्च ये चान्ये धृतराष्ट्रजाः। न्यहनस्तत् तदा सैन्यं स्थैर्गरुडनिःस्वनैः॥
en: Then king Duryodhana and also the son of Subala (Shakuni), Duhshasana and Vikarna and the sons of Dhritarashtra, riding on cars, the clatter of the wheels of which resembled the roars of Garuda, followed the lead of Karna and returned to the charge and began to kill the (Gandharva) army.

sa: स्वर्ग गच्छेत्यनुज्ञातस्त्र्यम्बकेण तदार्जुनः। प्रणम्य शिरसा राजन् प्राञ्जालर्देवमैक्षत॥
en: Then Arjuna was commanded by the threeeyed deity to "Go to heaven." O king, bowing down his head, he gazed at him with joined hands.

sa: उत्थानमभिजानन्ति सर्वभूतानि भारत। प्रत्यक्षं फलमश्नन्ति कर्मणां लोकसाक्षिकम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, all creatures perceive the impression of the pristine life and they visibly reap in this world the fruits of their acts.

sa: अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे ब्रह्मघोषानुनादिते॥ सुखमस्म्युषितः शैल तव सानुषु नित्यदा।
en: O king of mountains, on your lap filled with Apsaras and resounding with the recitations of the Vedas. I always lived happily on your table-lands

sa: रुरून् कृष्णमृगांश्चैव मेध्यांश्चान्यान् वनेचरान्। बाणैरुन्मथ्य विविधैर्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न्यवेदयत्॥
en: He dedicated the black and other kinds of deer and clean animals of the forest to those Brahmanas, after having killed them with his arrows.

sa: अहं नारायणो नाम शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः। यावद्युगानां विप्रचे सहपरिवर्तनात्॥
en: I am named Narayana, wielding the conch, the discus and the mace. O Brahmana Rishi, for a period of thousand times of the four। Yugas,

sa: तैः भीमबाहुबलोत्सृष्टैरायुधैर्यक्षरक्षसाम्। विनिकृत्तानि दृश्यन्ते शरीराणि शिरांसि च॥
en: And the heads and the bodies of the Rakshasas were seen cut off and mangled by the weapons hurled by the force of Bhima's arms.

sa: राहुरग्रसदादित्यमपर्वणि विशाम्पते। उल्का चाप्यपसव्येन पुरं कृत्वा व्यशीर्यत॥
en: Rahu came to devour the sun, although it was not the day of an eclipse, meteors began to fall, keeping the city to their right.

sa: भज्यमानेष्वनीकेषु धार्तराष्ट्रेषु सर्वशः। कर्णो वैकर्तनो राजंस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: O king, when the whole of the Kuru army broke and fled, the son of Surya (Karna) alone stood there as immoveable as a hill.

sa: अशुभैः कर्मभिश्चापि प्रायशः परिचिछिताः। दौष्कुल्या व्याधिबहुला दुरात्मानोऽप्रतापिनः॥
en: And they were generally marked by their wicked deeds, born in low family, afflicted with various diseases and became evil-minded and the terror of others.

sa: एवमेषा महाभाग प्रतिष्ठाने प्रतिष्ठिता। तीर्थयात्रा महापुण्या सर्वपापप्रमोचनी॥
en: O greatly exalted one, he (Bhishma) ended here (at Prayaga) his highly meritorious visits to the Tirthas which are ever capable of destroying all sins.

sa: आक्रीडं राजराजस्य कुबेरस्य महात्मनः। गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च देवैश्च परमार्चिताम्॥
en: It was the play-ground of the king of the kings, the high-souled Kubera. It was adorned swans by the Gandharvas, the Apsaras and the celestials.

sa: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाभाग पद्मलक्षणलक्षिताः। अद्यापि मुद्रा दृश्यन्ते तदद्भुतमरिंदम्॥
en: O greatly exalted one, O chastiser of foes, it is wonderful that in that Tirtha even today coins are found with the marks of lotus;

sa: बह्वन्नाच्छादनैयुक्तान् सगणानां पृथक् पृथक्। सर्वर्तुगुणसम्पन्नान् शिल्पिनोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: And their attendants, separately for each by thousands of artisans who were endued with all qualifications, they were filled with much food and many clothes.

sa: विमलाशोकमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां स्वर्गलोके महीयते।
en: Then going to Vimalashoka lake with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life and living there for one night, one becomes adored in the celestials region.

sa: नष्टशत्रुर्यदा स्कन्दः प्रयातस्तु महेश्वरम्। तदाब्रवीन्महासेनं परिष्वज्य पुरंदरः॥
en: When the enemies (of the celestials) were completely destroyed by Skanda and when Maheshvara went away, then Purandara embraced him and thus spoke to him,

sa: अध्वनि जातश्रमः क्षुत्तृष्णाभिभूतश्चैकस्मिन् देशे नीलं गहनं वनखण्डमपश्यत्॥
en: Fatigued and afflicted with hunger and thirst, he saw in that part of the country where he was (thus) led, a dark and dense forest.

sa: कुमारकोटिमासाद्य नियत: कुरुनन्दन। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, going next to Kumarkoti with subdued soul, one should bathe there and engage himself in worshipping the celestials and the Pitris.

sa: देशकालावुपायांश्च मङ्गलं स्वस्तिवृद्धये। युनक्ति मेधयाधीरो यथाशक्ति यथाबलम्॥
en: The man is by his intelligence and according to his might and power, brings place, time, means and auspicious rites for the acquisition of prosperity.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि पार्थस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। विस्तरेण कथामेतां यथास्त्राण्युपलब्धवान्॥
en: Janamejaya said : O exalted onc, I desire to hear in detail the account of the acquisition of weapons by Partha (Arjuna) of spotless deeds.

sa: तस्मिन्नभ्यर्चिते कृष्णे सुनीथः शत्रुकर्षणः। अतिताप्रेक्षणः कोपादुवाच मनुजाधिपान्॥
en: When Krishna received the first worship, that slayer of foes, Sunitha (Shishupala), with eyes red as copper in anger, thus addressed the kings (present there).

sa: अर्धयोजनविस्तारा पञ्चयोजनमायता। एतावती वेदिका तु पुण्या देवर्षिसेविता॥
en: It is said that the sacred Dabhika (Tirtha), frequented by the celestials and Rishis, is five yojanas in length and half a yojana in breadth.

sa: नागायुतसमप्राणः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः। गृहीतो व्यजहात् सत्त्वं वरदानविमोहितः॥
en: And seized in the gripe (of the serpent) and charmed by the boon it had received, the leonine-shouldered and mighty armed (Bhima) lost his strength.

sa: अल्पायुषो दरिद्राश्चधर्मिष्ठा मानवास्तथा। दीर्घायुषः समृद्धाश्च विधर्माणो युगक्षये॥
en: Those that are devoted to virtue then become poor and short-lived. At the end of the Yuga those that are sinful become wealthy and longlived.

sa: 'भवन्त्यल्पायुषः पापा रौद्रकर्मफलोदयाः। नाथन्तः सर्वकामानां नास्तिका भिन्नचेतसः॥
en: Their life became short and wicked and they paid the penalty of their terrible deeds; were covetous of everything, became atheists and indifferent in mind.

sa: तामसं युगमासाद्य कृष्णो भवति केशवः। वेदाचाराः प्रशाम्यन्तिधर्मयज्ञक्रियास्तथा॥
en: When this age appears, Keshava (Vishnu) assumes a black colour. The Vedas, the Institutes, the virtue, the sacrifices and religious observances all fall into disuse.

sa: ददर्श तत्र वैदर्भी सखीगणसमावृताम्। श्रिया च वरवर्णिनीम्॥
en: There he saw the daughter of the ruler of Vidharbhas, who was encircled by her handsminds, effulgent in beauty and forin and of fair color.

sa: तव देव शरीरस्था देवदानवराक्षसाः। यक्षगन्धर्वनागाश्च जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: O god, the celestials, the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the Yakshsas, the Gandharvas, the Nagas, may the whole universe mobile immobile are all within your body.

sa: कारस्करान्माहिषकान् कुरण्डान् केरलांस्तथा। कर्कोटकान् वीरकांश्च दुर्धर्माचं विवर्जयेत्॥
en: The Karaskaras, the Mahishkas, the Kurandas, the Keralas, the Karkotakas, the Virakas and other people who have no religion should always be avoided by men.

sa: उद्भिनरुधिरौ कृष्णौ भारद्वाजस्य सायकैः। शितैश्चितौ व्यरोचेतां कर्णिकारैरिवाचलौ॥
en: Pierced with the whetted shafts of Bharadvaja's son and profusely shedding blood, the two Krishnas appeared beautiful, like two mountains adorned with flowering Karnikara trees.

sa: द्रोणस्य रथपर्यन्तं रथिनो रथमास्थिताः। कम्पयन्तोऽभ्यवर्तन्त वेगमास्थाय मध्यमम्॥
en: Car-warriors mounted on their cars, causing the earth to shake under them and pouring their arrowy showers, proceeded towards Drona's car in a medium speed.

sa: मद्रराजो महेष्वासः शल्यः समितिशोभनः॥ दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं कर्णं सारथ्ये रथिनां वरः। किमभाषत वीरोऽसौ मद्राणामधिपो बली॥
en: On beholding the slaughter of Karna, what did the king of Madras, that mighty bowman, that ornament of assemblies, Shalya of the Shauvira tribe, that foremost of charioteers engaged in driving away the car (of Karna), that leading chief of the Madra warriors, who was possessed of mighty strength, say?

sa: तथा त्वमपि राधेय सिंहमात्मानमिच्छसि। अपश्यशत्रुदमनं नरव्याघ्र धनंजयम्॥
en: So do you, O son of Radha, consider yourself a lion for you do not see that subduer of foes, that foremost of men, Dhananjaya.

sa: उग्रकर्मा महेष्वासो नामतः कर्मतस्तथा। शाल्वराजो महाबाहुर्भीमसेनेन पातितः॥
en: The Shalya king of mighty strength and active habits, who was a grcat bowman both in name and deeds, was slain in battle by Bhimasena.

sa: कृष्णेन च गृहीताश्वमभेद्यकवचावृतः। गाण्डीवमजरं दिव्यं धनुरादाय वीर्यमान्॥
en: The steeds of which were guided by Krishna. And that puissant one was clad in impenetrable armour and wielding his celestial and undecaying bow Gandiva.

sa: प्रताप्यमानाः सूर्येण हन्यमानाश्च सायकैः। अन्वपद्यन्त पञ्चालास्तदा संत्रस्तचेतसः॥
en: Scorched with the rays of the sun and wounded with the arrows of Drona, the Panchalas, panic struck as they were, became seized with anxiety.

sa: तेषामापततां शूरः पञ्चालानां तरस्विनाम्। आदत्तासूशरैः कर्णः पतङ्गानामिवानलः॥
en: Like the flaming fire consuming myriads of insects that irrepressible Karna with his shafts devoured these swift-armed. Panchalas as they approached him in battle array.

sa: दशभिः सात्वतस्यार्थे भीमोऽहन् बाह्निकात्मजम्। सोमदत्तोऽप्यसम्भ्रान्तो भीममाईच्छितैः शरैः॥
en: Bhima also, for the sake of Sattvata, struck the son of Valhika with ten arrows. And the dauntless Somadatta also pierced Bhima with sharpened arrows.

sa: तावन्योन्यं भृशं विदध्वा रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ॥ अन्योन्याभिहतौ रेजतुर्वृषभाविव।
en: Both the warriors, who were smeared with blood, after having penetrated each other deeply, looked like two bulls, that wounded each other with their horns.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच ततः स तपसा चैव दमेन नियमेन च। पूजोपहारबलिभिर्होममन्त्रपुरस्कृतैः॥ आराधयितवान् शर्वं बहून् वर्षगणांस्तदा।
en: Duryodhana said Thereupon he, by means of severe penances, by subduing his souls and by the observance of vows, as also by means of performing worship, offerings and sacrifices, followed by the performance of Homa; attended with the utterance of the Mantras, began to worship Bhava through many long years.

sa: धनुश्च पुनरन्येन चकर्तास्य महारथः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरश्चैव बाणैर्विव्याध वाजिनः।
en: Duryodhana again shot an arrow which had cut-off the bow with Yudhishthira and penetrated his four horses by another four arrows he shot at them.

sa: नरास्तु बहवस्तत्र समाजग्मुः परस्परम्। गदाभिर्मुसलैश्चैव नानाशस्त्रैश्च संयुगे॥
en: There (on the field of battle) large numbers of men destroyed one another in heaps, by means of maces, short clubs and several other weapons.

sa: तद्धत्वा सर्वभूतानामभावकृतनिश्चयम्। ततो बालकः स्वरगादेवं धर्मः सुदुर्विदः॥
en: Therefore Valaka, having killed the beast that was bent upon killing all the animals, went to heaven. Morality is, therefore, very difficult to be understood.

sa: व्यामोहिते तु तनये बाह्रीकस्तमुपाद्रवत्॥ विसृजञ्छरवर्षाणि कालवर्षीव तोयदः।
en: His son being deprived of consciousness, Valhika, discharging showers of arrows like the clouds (pouring) torrents of rain during (the rainy, season), rushed at him.

sa: यतमानोऽर्जुनं प्रीत्या प्रत्यवारयदुत्स्मयन्। ततोऽन्तरिक्षे देवाश्च गन्धर्वाश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Drona, vigorously striving cheerfully resisted Arjuna (in his turn) being filled with wonder all the while. Then in the welkin, thousands of celestial and Gandharvas,

sa: स वध्यमानो बहुधा राजपुत्रैर्महारथैः। क्रोधमाहारयत् तेषामभावाय द्विजर्षभः॥
en: Thus wounded by those princes, all mighty car-warriors, that foremost of the regenerate wrought himself up with anger, for putting an end to their existence.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महारथः। शरैरनेकसाहस्रैः पूरयामास सर्वतः॥
en: Thus depriving Yudhishthira of the use of his bow, that mighty warrior Drona quickly filled the pores of the latter's body with many thousand shafts.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विस्थो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। त्रिगर्तसेनापतिना स्वरथेनापवाहितः॥
en: Was carried away by the commander of the Trigartta divisions on his own chariot. O Bharata, then the grandson of Sini once more assailed him.

sa: त्रिदशैरपि चास्यद्भिः शरवर्ष समन्ततः। अशक्यस्तदयं जेतुं स्रवद्भिर्मासशोणितम्॥
en: He is incapable of being vanquished in battle by the very gods shooting showers of arrow in all directions and discharging flesh and blood profusely.

sa: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य केशवः पार्थमब्रवीत्। असावायति शैनेयस्तव पार्थ पदानुगः॥
en: Beholding Satyaki Satyaki come them, Keshava addressing Arjuna said "There comes the grandson of Sini, O son of Pritha, pursuing the track (opened by you).

sa: यमाश्रित्य महाबाहुं विद्विषां जयकाङ्क्षया। दुर्योधनोऽकरोद् वैरं पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महारथैः॥
en: Having taken refuge under the mighty arms of that imperishable slayer of innumerable foes, Duryodhana made enemies of the sons of Pandu, those great car-warriors.

sa: पिप्रीषुस्तव पुत्राणां संग्रामेष्वपराजितः। सायकौघेन बलवान् क्षिप्रकारी महाबलः॥
en: That puissant, light-handed and highly powerful one, devoted to the good of your sons and never vanquished in battle, by means of showers of arrows.

sa: ततो नारायणस्तस्माच्छरभागाद् विनिःसृतः। वृषरूपं समास्थाय उनहार महारथम्॥
en: Thereupon Narayana came out of the pointed head of that arrow; and then having taken-up the form of a bull lifted up that huge car.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा सैनिकान् सर्वाञ्जयापेक्षी नराधिपः। पार्थमाभाष्य संरम्भादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having thus spoken to the soldiers, the king desirous of victory, addressing Pritha's son, out of anger, said these wordsपार्थ यच्छिक्षितं तेऽस्त्रं दिव्यं पार्थिवमेव च।

sa: राजानं विदुस्थापि प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। आश्वासयामास तदा सिञ्चस्तोयेन कौरवम्॥
en: Thereupon Vidura, too, began to sprinkle water over the face of that descendant of Kuru and consoled that powerful monarch, who had eyes of wisdom.

sa: प्राहिणोत् कृतसंरम्भः शरान् बहिणवाससः। स्वर्णपुङ्खाशिलाधौतान् यमदण्डोपमान् मृधे॥
en: Wrathfully pierced the latter with many arrows furnished with wings of peacock's feathers or of gold and whetted on stone and resembling darts of Death.

sa: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि यमकानीतराणि च। चरन्तौ युद्धमार्गशो ततक्षतुरथेषुभिः॥
en: Both versed in various modes of warfare, they careered over the field, displaying various motions with their chariots and mangling one another with their shafts.

sa: तयोर्विसृजतोरेवं शरजालानि मारिष। वायुरप्यन्तरा राजन् नाशक्नोत् प्रतिसर्पितुम्॥
en: The arrowy showers discharged by them were so thick that the very wind, O sire, could not find space for blowing through them, O king.

sa: अथास्य बहुर्भिर्बाणैरच्छिनत् परमास्त्रवित्॥ समार्गणगणं राजन् कृतवर्मा शरासनम्।
en: O monarch, then Kritavarman acquainted with many excellent weapons, cut-off by means of his arrows, the bow of Satyaki having arrows fixed on its string.

sa: आकर्णपूर्णमाचार्यो बलवानभ्यवासृजत्। स हत्वा क्षत्रधर्माणं जगाम धरणीतलम्॥
en: The puissant Preceptor let it go drawing the bow-string back to the very ears. That arrow then killing Kshatradharman fell down on the Earth's surface.

sa: विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैौणिं पञ्चभिराहवे। जीमूताविव धर्मान्ते तो शरौघप्रवर्षिणौ॥
en: And with fine sharp arrows pierced Drona's son in battle. Like two clouds at the expiration of summer, those two warriors, pouring showers of arrows.

sa: तथा प्रयाते राजेन्द्र कर्णे नरवरोत्तमे। धनंजयमभिप्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: O lord of kings, when Karna, that best of person had started for battle, the king of righteousness (Yudhishthira) beheld Dhananjaya and addressed him sayingपश्य

sa: ततः प्रयत्नमातिष्ठदाचार्यस्तस्य वारणे। न चास्यास्त्राणि राजेन्द्र प्रादुरासन्महात्मनः॥
en: The preceptor then did not endeavour to baffle that shaft, nor did also the celestial was weapons of that high-souled hero appear at his command.

sa: राजानमभिधावन्तं शरैरावृत्य रोदसी। क्रुद्धः प्रच्छादयामास शरजालेन मारुतिः॥
en: Covering the earth and sky with arrows, the son of the Wind-god (Bhima) covered him with a shower of arrows while he pursued the king.

sa: अथैनं रथवंशेन सर्वतः संनिवार्य ते। अवाकिरज्छरवातैः परमधन्विनः॥
en: Then all those excellent bowmen waxing worth and surrounding him with hosts of cars on all sides, began to pour their arrowy showers on them.

sa: उद्यम्यात्मानमुग्राय कर्मणे सपदानुगाः॥ चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ।
en: Attend by his followers and bent on achieving a fierce feat. Mean-while the two protectors of Arjuna's car-wheels, viz., the Panchala princes, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjas.

sa: देवर्षिसिद्धगन्धर्वाः साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्। मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्ष च विद्याधरगणास्तथा॥
en: The celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Gandharvas, applauded them both saying 'Excellent, Excellent'; and hosts of Vidyadharas then showered flowers on those two heroes.

sa: त्वत्सहायो नरव्याघ्र लोकानां हितकाम्यया। हिडिम्बवककिर्मीरा भीमसेनेन पातिताः॥
en: With your aid, in order to achieve the word's welfare, O foremost of men, Hidimba and Vaka and Krimitra had all been slain by Bhimasena.

sa: अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रो द्रौणिमाच्छादयद् रणे॥ अथ संधाय वायव्यमस्रमसविदां वरः।
en: Covered the son of Drona with furious showers of stones in battle. Thereupon, aiming ihe Vayavya weapon, that foremost of those skilled in weapons (viz.,)

sa: तं पराङमुखमालोक्य पदाति सूतनन्दनम्। कौन्तेयशरसंछन्नं राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the son of Suta turn away and walk on foot and covered with the arrows shot from the bow of Kunti's son, king Duryodhana

sa: अथाब्रवीद्धष्टमना वासुदेवं धनंजयः। पश्य वृष्णिप्रवीरेण क्रीडन्तं कुरुपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then Dhananjaya, with cheerful heart addressing Vasudeva's son said-"Behold that foremost among the Kurus and that best hero among the Vrishni's, sport with each other.

sa: स्वर्णचित्रतनुत्रैश्च भाण्डैश्च गजवाजिनाम्। किरीटशतसंकीर्णा तत्र तत्र समाचिता॥
en: With armours decked with gold, with the caparisons and trappings of elephants and horses and with hundreds of diadems, strewn all over with these things.

sa: दुर्योधनसहिते युक्तमस्मदुःखाय चोद्यतम्। अप्रधृष्यं महायुद्धे देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: Who was the destroyer of others' armies and the oppressor of the enemies and was bent upon doing Duryodhana a good turn and afflicting us;

sa: विनष्टैः पाण्डवेयैश्च सशैलवनकाननाम्। वसुंधरामिमां कर्ण भोक्ष्यामो हतकण्टकाम्॥
en: When the Pandavas will be destroyed, O Karna, we shall enjoy this earth with its mountains, gardens and forests, without a thorn in our sides.

sa: ध्मापयन् वारिजं राजन् हेमजालविभूषितम्। विधुन्वानो महचापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम्॥
en: O monarch, (Karna then began) to blow his conch adorned with a net-work of gold and also to shake his terrible bow studded with gold.

sa: ततः साधुविसृष्टेन क्षुरेणानतपर्वणा। छित्त्वा शरासनं शत्रो गमामित्रमार्दयत्॥
en: Thereupon, he (Kshemadhurti), having cutoff his enemy's bow by means of an arrow well-shot, razor-like and straight, highly oppressed that elephant belonging to his foe.

sa: गन्धर्वनगराकारान् रथांश्च निहतेश्वरान्। छिन्नध्वजपताकाक्षान् विचक्रान् हतसारथीन्॥ निकृत्तकूबरयुगान् भग्नेषाबन्धुरान् प्रभो। पश्य पार्थ हयान् भूमौ विमानोपमदर्शनान्॥
en: Behold, O Partha, O lord, these cars resembling the city of the Gandharvas, with their lords slain and their standards, banners and Akshas cut to pieces, deprived of their wheels and charioteers, with their yokes cut to pieces, with broken shafts and crests and looking (splendid) like the celestial vehicles.

sa: र्गाण्डीवमुक्तैर्विशिखैलद्धिः। सकुण्डलं भानुमदुत्तमाङ्गं कायात् प्रकृत्तं युधि सव्यसाचिन्॥
en: Have you today, O Savyasachin, severed that ear-ring bedecked splendid head of Karna off from his body with your fiery shafts discharged from the Gandiva.

sa: नाशक्नुवन्नवस्थातुं काल्यमाना महात्मना॥ कर्णेनाभ्याहता राजन् पञ्चालाः परमेषुभिः।
en: Afflicted by that illustrious warrior Karna, they could not then stay on the field. O king, the Panchalas then mangled with excellent shafts by Karna.

sa: शरं च सूर्यरश्म्याभमत्युग्रमनिवारणम्॥ हा हतोऽसीति राजानमुक्त्वामुञ्चद् युधिष्ठिरः।
en: Omajesty! Yudhishthira, then shot a dreadful and target hitting arrow glowing like sun beams at your son, king Duryodhana with a declaration-"Oh! You are killed."

sa: तत्राद्भुतमिमं द्रौणिर्दर्शयामास विक्रमम्। अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
en: There, 0 Bharata, the son of Drona displayed such wonderful exploits as are incapable of being achieved by any other being among all the creatures.

sa: ततः समाकुले तस्मिन् वर्तमाने महाभये। अभ्यद्रवञ्जिघांसन्तः परस्परवधैषिणः॥
en: Then in that general and dreadful engagement, the fighters rushed, one against another, smiting one another and desirous of depriving one another of his life.

sa: उस्थितान्यगणेयानि कबधानि समन्ततः। चिह्नभूतानि जगतो विनाशार्थाय भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, innumerable headless bodies were seen rising from the ground, an omen to indicate that the destruction of the world is near.

sa: पौत्रं तव पुरस्कृत्य लक्ष्मणं प्रियदर्शनम्। अन्योन्यसमदुःखास्ते अन्योन्यसमसाहसाः॥
en: Placing at their head your handsome grandson Lakshmana, they proceeded to battle, resolved to share one another's grief, emulating one another in deeds of valour.

sa: कृताभिसमयाः सर्वे सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। रक्ताम्बरधराः सर्वे सर्वे रक्तविभूषणाः॥
en: All of them sword to help one another, all owned standards decked with gold; all wore red raiment's and all were decorated with crimson ornaments.

sa: क्रव्यादास्तर्पयिष्यामि द्रावयिष्यामि शात्रवान्। सुहृदो नन्दयिष्यामि प्रमथिष्यामि सैन्धवम्॥
en: Tomorrow will I afford gratification to the flesh-eaters and will scatter my enemies and delight my friends and completely destroy the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: शूराणं हर्षजननो भीरूणां भयवर्धनः। द्यावापृथिव्योर्विवरं पूरयामास सर्वतः॥
en: That noise that imparted delight to the heroes and enhanced the terrors of the cowards, filled the whole interval between the earth and the skies.

sa: भीष्मः समरविक्रान्तः पाण्डवेयस्य भारत। जघान समरे योधानसंख्येयपराक्रमः॥
en: 0 Bharata, Bhishma of immeasurable prowess, displaying his might in battle, slew a large number of warriors of the Pandava host in that (sanguinary) engagement.

sa: अभिमन्युप्रभृतयः पाण्डवानां महारथाः। अभ्यधावन् परीप्सन्तः प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजान्।।२८।
en: The mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host, such as Abhimanyu and others, rushed, forward desirous of rescuing him, setting their own dear lives at naught.

sa: ते कृत्वा समरव्यूहं सूचीमुखमरिंदमाः। बिभिदुर्धार्तराष्ट्राणां तद् स्थानीकमाहवे॥
en: Those grinders of foes forming their troops in the array known as Suchimukha, penetrated, in that battle, into that car-division of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: ततस्ते जातसंरम्भाः परस्परकृतागसः। अन्योन्यस्पर्धया राजन् व्यायच्छन्त महारथाः॥
en: O king, then those great car-warriors remembering the great injuries they had suffered, challenged one another in anger and tried their utmost (to win victory).

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः कपर्दी वृषभध्वजः। पश्यतामेव विप्राणां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: So saying, Mahadeva, otherwise, known as Kapardin, and having the bull for his carrier, vanished even then and there while the Brahmanas were looking on.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ क्षत्रियान् प्रवपञ्छरैः। आससाद दुराधर्षः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Having thus spoken, o foremost of the Bharatas, that invincible hero scattering his arrows broadcast among the Kshatriyas, rushed against the ranks of the Pandavas,

sa: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः। यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते॥
en: The acts of the man who is devoid of attachment, who is free from passions and whose mind is steady in knowledge, are all destroyed.

sa: नानावादिवशब्देन पाञ्चजन्यस्वनेन च। देवदत्तस्य घोषेण गाण्डीवनिनदेन च॥
en: The sounds of various musical instruments, the blasts of Panchajanya and Devadatta (the conchs of Arjuna and Krishna) and the crackling of the bow Gandiva.

sa: अभिघातप्रभावाच्च पावकः समजायत। शराः स्वसमुत्थेन प्रदीप्ताचित्रभानुना॥ ते
en: And from the clashing of weapons there sprang up a fire and those arrows were ablaze owing to the fire brought into existence by them.

sa: ते गजा विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्युधि गाण्डीवचोदितैः। अनेकशतसाहस्रः सर्वाङ्गेषु समर्पिताः॥
en: The elephants were pierced on every part of their bodies with the arrows of keen points shot by hundreds and thousands from the bow Gandiva.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ शल्यश्चैतान् न्यवारयन्। ते त्वार्यधर्मसंरब्धा दुर्निवारा दुरासदाः॥
en: Those irresistible and invincible warriors, the Panchalas and the Pandavas, all inflamed with righteous indignation, did not avoid Drona, though afflicted with showers of arrows.

sa: प्रज्ञयाभ्यधिकाञ्शूरान् गुणयुक्तान् बहूनपि। जयन्त्यल्पतरा येन तन्निबोध विशाम्पते॥
en: we O majesty! I tell you the manner by which handful warriors conquer the wiser and meritorious majority of warriors. Please, listen to it carefully.

sa: चक्ररक्षो तु पाञ्चाल्यावर्जुनस्य पदानुगौ। पर्यवारयदायान्तौ कृतवर्मा रथेषुभिः॥
en: Then with his arrows, Kritavarman opposed the two Panchala princes who were following in the wake of Arjuna, for protecting the wheels of his car.

sa: पाण्ड्यमिन्द्रमिवायान्तमसुरान् प्रति दुर्जयम्। समर्थः सायकौधेन वृषसेनो न्यवारयत्॥
en: Vrishasena, a worthy combatant, checked with an arrowy shower, king Pandya who was rushing to battle like Indra rushing after the Asuras for slaying them.

sa: न संदधन् न चाकर्षन् न विमुञ्जन् न चोद्वहन्। मण्डलेनैव धनुषा नृत्यन् पार्थः स्म दृश्यते॥
en: Nobody was able then to detect when Arjuna took out his arrows or fix them on the string of his bows or drew the string back or discharged them. But Partha was then seen only to dance on the terrace of his chariot with his bow drawn to a circle.

sa: सा कन्या तु महाराज प्रविश्याश्रममण्डलम्। यमुनातीरमाश्रित्य तपस्तेपेऽतिमानुषम्।॥
en: That maiden, O great king, having entered the pale of a secluded pot, began practicing austerities of superhuman endurance, on the banks of the Yamuna,

sa: तथा गजानां कदनं कुर्वाणमनिलात्मजम्। क्रूद्धोदोधनोऽभ्येत्य प्रत्यविध्यच्छितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon Duryodhana excited with wrath, approached and pierced with whetted shafts the son of the Wind who was afflicting his (Duryodhana's) own division of elephants.

sa: ततो दौःशासनिं कार्पोिर्विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः। संरम्भाद रक्तनयनो वाक्यमुच्चैरथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereafter Krishna's nephew having pierced Dushasana's son with ten swiftcoursing arrows, spoke these words at the top of his voice, with eyes red in rage.

sa: व्यादिदेश सवाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्। सगजाश्वमनुष्याणां ये च शिल्पोपजीविनः॥
en: Together with elephants and steeds and other followers, provisions of the best kind, as well as for those who lived by means of mechanical arts.

sa: अनूपाधिपतिश्चैव नीलः स्वबलमास्थितः। महता रथवंशेन हैडिम्बं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: And Nila the sovereign of the low countries accompanied by his own divisions. They surrounded the son of Hidimba with a mighty division of cars.

sa: स्वयमेव ततः पश्चाद् विराटदुपदान्वितः। अथापरैर्महीपालैः सह प्रायान्महीपतिः॥
en: Last of all, that ruler of the earth himself went forth in the rear, with other rulers of the earth, accompanied by Virata and Drupada.

sa: दन्तान्भक्त्वा सहस्रस्य कर्णान् नासान्यकृन्तत। ततः सप्तसहस्राणां कटुधूपमपाययत्॥
en: He splitted the teeth and cu-off nose and ears of one thousand Kshatriyas and forcibly made seven thousand kings to sip the bitter Dhupa (herb).

sa: सखड्गस्य महाराज चरतस्तस्य संयुगे। नान्तरं ददृशे द्रौणिस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: As he (Shikhandin) whirled about on the field, O mighty monarch, Drona's son could not find any vulnerable point, and this seemed indeed very wonderful.

sa: प्रादुरासीद् रजस्तीवं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। ध्वजानां धूयमानानां सहसा मातरिश्वना॥ किङ्किणीजालबद्धानां काञ्चनस्रग्वराम्बरैः। महतां सपताकानामादित्यसमतेजसाम्॥ सर्वं झणझणीभूतमासीत् तालवनेष्विव। एवं ते पुरुषव्याघ्राः पाण्डवा युद्धनन्दिनः॥ व्यवस्थिताः प्रतिव्यूह्य तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्। असन्त इव मज्जा नो योधानां भरतर्षभ॥ दृष्ट्वाऽग्रतो भीमसेनं गदापाणिमवस्थितम्॥
en: So thick was the dust that rose that nothing could be seen. The high standards (on the cars) adorned with strings of bells, decked with golden ornaments, garlands of flowers and rich cloths and graced with banners, and loO king like the sun in splendor, being suddenly shaken by the wind gave out a loud jingling noise like that of a forest of palmyra trees. having thus placed their troops in battle-array against the army of your son, and sucking, as it were, the marrow of our warriors and warriors and loO king at Bhimsena who stood at the head of the army with his mace in hand, it was thus that those foremost of men, the Pandavas, who over take delight in battle, stood.

sa: ताडितास्ताड्यमानाश्च तोमरट्रिपरश्वधैः। पेतुरार्तस्वनं कृत्वा तदा विशसने गजा॥
en: Then in that carnage, elephants fell down uttering distressful roars, being pierced or in the act of being pierced with lances, swords and battle axes.

sa: सम्पातेष्वभिघातेषु निपातेष्वसिचर्मणोः। न तयोरन्तरं कश्चिद् ददर्श नरसिंहयोः॥
en: Between those two foremost of men no person could notice any distinctiun regarding the whirl, the strokes and the descent of their swords and shields.

sa: शिवाभिरशिवाभिश्च रुवद्भिभैरवं रवम्। धोकमायोधनं जज्ञे भूतसंघैः समाकुलम्॥
en: Then the field of battle assumed a dreadful sight abounding as at did with the spirits of the dead and the ominous jackals howling (tediously).

sa: सृञ्जयं नारदोऽभ्येत्य तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर। कामानामवितृप्तस्त्वं सृञ्जयेह मरिष्यसि॥
en: King Srinjaya. O Yudhishthira listen on 10 those words. Narada said : You shall have to die, O Srinjaya, with many of your desirc', unfulfiled.

sa: अर्जुनश्चापि संक्रुद्धः क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः। अयोधयत संग्रामे वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्॥
en: In that battle Arjuna also inflamed with many wrath fought with many best of Kshatriyas like the wielder of the thunder-bolt fighting against the Asuras.

sa: गिरिव्रजगताश्चापि नग्नजित्प्रमुखा नृपाः। अम्बष्ठाश्च विदेहाश्च गान्धाराश्च जितास्त्वया॥
en: You also vanquished the monarchs who was stopping at Girivraja and who was headed by Nagnajit, as also the Ambasthas, the Vidchas and the Gandharvas.

sa: विद्युतं मेघमध्यस्थां भ्राजमानामिवाम्बरे। ददृशुर्गाण्डिवं योधा रुक्मपृष्ठं महामृधे॥
en: In that terrible encounter, the warriors saw Arjuna's gold mounted Gandiva appear beautiful like flashes of lightning illumining a mass of clouds in the welkin.

sa: ते मनः क्रूरमाधाय समभित्यक्तजीविताः। पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त सर्व एवोच्छ्रितध्वजाः॥
en: Then all the (Kuru) warriors, full of cruel intentions and devoid of the desire of living, rushed upon the Pandavas with their standards all upraised.

sa: आगतः सर्वभूतानामनुकम्पार्थमच्युतः। ततोऽहमब्रुवं सूत मन्दं दुर्योधनं तदा॥
en: Then, O Suta, I said unto the wicked Duryodhana-"With the son of Vasudeva as the mediator, O son, do you conclude peace with the Pandavas.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमुखास्त्वन्ये तव सैन्यमयोधयन्। तथैव तावकाः सर्वे पाण्डुसैन्यमयोधयन्॥
en: Other warriors of the Pandava host headed by Dhrishtadyumna himself, engaged with your warriors; so also your warriors fought against the troops of the Pandavas.

sa: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्॥
en: If even this you are unable to do, then resort to devotion in Me. Subduing your Self, abandon the desire for the fruits of actions.

sa: कश्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति। अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि॥
en: Does he, O mighty-armed, having fallen from both, go to ruin like a broken cloud, being without support and deluded of the path to Brahma?

sa: ततो महात्मा यक्षेन्द्रः प्रत्युवाचानुगामिनः। सर्वान् यक्षगणांस्तात शापस्यान्तचिकीर्षया॥
en: Then that high-souled lord of the Yakshas, o son, answered his followers, all those Yakshas, with the desire of setting a limit to (his) curse.

sa: ब्रह्मस्त्रेण सुसंयुक्तं त शरं लोमवाहिनम्॥ ददृशुर्देवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः।
en: That winged arrow, endued with the force of the Brahma weapon, was seen by the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, the Uragas and the Rakshasas.

sa: दशमेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते रथानीकं शिखण्डिनः। अहदनिशितैर्बाणैः कृष्णवर्मेव काननम्॥ तं शिखण्डी त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं कालसृष्टमिवान्तकम्॥
en: And they were unable to resist him who then looked like Death's self with wide-open mouth. On the tenth day of the battle, Bhishma began to consume with his sharp arrows the car-host of Shikhandin like fire consuming a forest. Then Shikhandin with three arrows pierced Bhishma between his breasts,

sa: ततो दिव्यास्त्रविच्छूरः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। विसृजन्निषुजालानि सहसा तान्यताडयत्॥
en: Thereat that heroic son of Kunti, by name Dhananjaya, versed in the use of celestial weapons, discharging a net-work of arrows, simultaneously attacked them all.

sa: नाकम्पयत संग्रामे विव्याध च पुनः शरैः। कौसल्यस्य धनुश्चापि पुनश्चिच्छेद फाल्गुनिः॥ आजघान शरैश्चापि त्रिंशता कङ्कपत्रिभिः। सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय राजपुत्रो बृहद्बलः॥ फाल्गुनिं समरे क्रुद्धो विव्याध बहुभिः शरैः। तयोर्युद्धं समभवद् भीष्महेतोः परंतप॥ संरब्धयोर्महाराज समरे चित्रयोधिनोः। यथा देवासुरे युद्धे बलिवासवयोरभूत्॥
en: But he could not make the latter tremble in battle before him, and so again pierced him with many arrows. Then the son of Phalguna cut off the bow of the Kosala king once more; and he struck him with thirty shafts furnished with wings of the Kanka feather. Thereupon that prince Brihadbala taking up another bow, and waxing irascible, pierced with many an arrow the son of Phalguna. Indeed, O afflicter of enemies, the battle, that took place for the sake of Bhishma, between them both, O king, inflamed with anger and both well versed in all manner of warfare, was like that between Bali and Vasava in the days of yore on the occasion of the war between the celestial and the Asuras.

sa: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम्। कौरवो द्रोणपुत्रश्च सहितावभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Beholding him stand with his uplifted mace like the crested Kailasa mountain, the Kuru king and the son of Drona, united together, rushed against him.

sa: वेलामुद्वर्तयन्तीव क्षोभयन्तो वसुंधराम्॥ वृक्षानुन्मथ्य वान्त्युग्रा वाताः शर्करकर्षिणः।
en: Having exceedingly swelled, seem ready to overflow their banks in order to afflict the earth. Fearful winds with stones are blowing crushing all the trees.

sa: तस्य तच्छतधा चर्म व्यधमत् सायकैस्तथा॥ रथादनवरूढस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: But before he (Bhishma) could descend from his chariot, Arjuna with his shafts splintered that buckler into hundred fragments. Indeed that looked like something marvelous.

sa: पुण्डरीकवनानीव विध्यस्तानि समन्ततः। विनिकर्णानि योधानां वदनानि चकाशिरे॥
en: The countenance of the warriors scattered here and there, looked charming like an assemblage of plucked off lotuses lying crushed and strewn about the field.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा घोररूपां दुरासदाम्। अभिमन्युः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद भुजगोपमाम्॥
en: The Abhimanyu, cut down with his keen pointed arrows, that dreadful and irresistible lances that resembled a snake and that was coursing swiftly toward himself.

sa: अभिजातोऽस्मि सिद्धोऽस्मि नास्मि केवलमानुषः। इत्येभिर्हेतुभिस्तस्य त्रिभिश्चित्तं प्रसिच्यते॥
en: In prosperity one thinks,-I am of highbirth.-I can do whatever I like.-I am not an ordinary person.-His mind because soaked with these three vain thoughts.

sa: तं प्रजासु विधर्माणं रागद्वेषवशानुगम्। मन्त्रपूतैः कुशैर्जघ्नुर्ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: Vena, a slave of anger and malice, become impious and tyrannical towards all creatures. The Brahmavadin Rishis killed him with Kusha blades inspired with Mantras.

sa: प्रयतेथा युधिष्ठिर। न ह्युस्थानमृते दैवं राज्ञामर्थं प्रसादयेत्॥
en: O son, you should always exert promptly, O Yudhishthira, for without exertion and manliness mere destiny never accomplishes the objects the kings wish to achieve.

sa: हरेत् कीर्ति धर्ममस्योपरुर्ध्या दर्थे दीर्घ वीर्यमस्योपहन्यात्। रिपुढेष्टा दुर्बलो वा बली वा तस्माच्छनोनॆव हीयेद् यतात्मा॥
en: An enemy, strong or weak, impelled by malice, may very soon destroy the fame of a king, impede the acquisition of religious merit by him; and deprive him of even his energy. Therefore, a king, who is of a controlled mind, should never be careless when he has an enemy.

sa: विनयेच्चापि दुर्वृत्तान् प्रहारैरपि पार्थिवः। सान्त्वेनोपप्रदानेन शिष्टांश्च परिपालयेत्॥
en: The wicked should be punished by the king with corporal punishments. The king should maintain all good men with sweet speeches and presents of riches.

sa: तमात्मजान्तकरणं पिता पुत्रवधार्दितः। अप्रीयमाणाः शोकातः पाण्डवं परिषस्वजे॥
en: Greatly stricken with grief for the slaughter of his sons, Dhritarashtra unwillingly embraced the eldest son of Pandu, who was the cause of that slaughter.

sa: सर्वे स्वर्गतिमिच्छन्ति सुयुद्धेनातिमन्यवः। क्षोभयेयुरनीकानि सागरं मकरा यथा।॥
en: Filled with wrath, heroes wish to acquire blessedness in heaven by fighting fairly. Like Makaras agitating the sea, they agitate the ranks of the enemy.

sa: त्यागवाजन्ममरणे नाप्नोतीति श्रुतिर्यदा॥ प्राप्तवा कृतमतिर्ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।
en: The Shrutis say that he who practices renunciation escapes from birth and death, and obtaining the right way, that person of controlled mind, attains Brahman.

sa: परस्परं सुसूक्ष्मेषु शोकेष्वाश्वासयंस्तदा। ताः शोकविह्वला राजन्नवैक्षन्त परस्परम्॥
en: Formerly they used to console each other while stricken with even slightest grief, Stupefied by grief, they, O king, could not look upon each other.

sa: देवा मनुष्याः पितरो गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसाः॥ यज्ञमेवोपजीवन्ति नास्ति चेष्टमराजके।
en: The gods, men, Pitris, Gandharvas, Uragas, and Rakshasas, all derive their support from sacrifices. In a country having no king, their can be no sacrifice.

sa: यदैषामम्ब पितरौ जातकामावुभावपि। संजातधनरत्नेषु तदैव निहता नृपाः॥
en: Alas, O mother, those kings have been killed just at that time, when their parents expected to reap the fruits of their power and riches.

sa: शिरोभिः पतितैर्हस्तैः सर्वाङ्गै!थशः कृतैः। इतरेतरसम्पृक्तैराकीर्णा भाति मेदिनी॥
en: Secing many headless trunks of great beauty, and many heads without trunks, those fair ladies and lying unconscious on the ground for a long while.

sa: रसायनविदश्चैव सुप्रयुक्तरसायनाः। दृश्यन्ते जरया भग्ना नगा नागैरिवोत्तमैः॥
en: Despite the wise application of chemical compounds, men well-versed in chemistry, are seen to be broken down by decrepitude like trees broken down by elephants.

sa: उक्तवत्यसि तीव्राणि वाक्यानि पुरुषोत्तमम्। क्षत्रधर्मानुरूपाणि तानि संस्मर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Those bitter words were addressed by you to Krishna, that foremost of persons. You should recollect these words that were so consistent with Kshatriya usages.

sa: धर्ममूलः सदैवार्थः कामोऽर्थफलमुच्यते। संकल्पमूलास्ते सर्वे संकल्पो विषयात्मकः॥
en: Profit originates f um virtue, and Pleasure is the fruit of Profit. All the three again originate from Will. Will is connected with the objects.

sa: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् भयमुत्पन्नमपि मूलं निकृन्तति। कामं विश्वासयेदन्यान् परेषां च न विश्वसेत्॥
en: One, who is not worthy of confidence should not be trusted; nor should too much trust be reposed in a person worthy of trust. The danger originating from blind confidence engenders absolute destruction. One should try to sccure the confidence of others. One, however, should never place confidence in others.

sa: शरप्रसूनसङ्काशं महीविवरशायिनम्॥ नकुलं हरिणं नाम चपलं ताम्रलोचनम्।
en: It was a restless mongoose of coppery eyes, of the name of Harita. Living in holes underneath, its body resembled the flower of a reed.

sa: अथवैकोऽहमेकाहमेकैकस्मिन् वनस्पतौ। चरन् भैक्ष्यं मुनिर्मुण्डः क्षपयिष्ये कलेवरम्॥
en: Or, living alone and observing the vow of silence, with iny head shaved clean, I shall live by begging each day of only one trees.

sa: तमेवाभिमुखो पीठे प्रदीप्ते काञ्चने शुभे। सात्यकिर्वासुदेवश्च निषीदतुररिन्दमौ॥
en: On another seat, beautiful and shining and made of gold, sat, with face directed towards him, those two destroyer of foes, viz., Satyaki and Vasudeva.

sa: स वीर्यमदमत्तत्वाद् भीष्मद्रोणावुपाश्रितः। रथमारोप्य तां कन्यामाजहार नराधिपः॥
en: Elated with the pride of power and relying upon Bhishma and Drona, king Duryodhana taking up that maiden on his car, carried her away forcibly.

sa: शिरस्तचापि नमुचेस्तत्रैवाप्लुत्य भारत। लोकान् कामदुघान् प्राप्तमक्षयान् राजसत्तम॥
en: The head of Namuchi also dropped into that stream O Bharata and Asura gained many blessed regions, O best of kings, that granted ever wish.”

sa: कर्मारारिश्शालासु ज्वलेदग्निः सुरक्षितः। गृहाणि च प्रवेश्यान्तर्विधेयः स्याद्भुताशनः॥
en: Particular care should be taken of the fires lighted in smitheries and lying-in chambers. Fires in the houses of the inhabitants should be well covered.

sa: कूजंश्चपलनेत्रोऽयं कौशिको मां निरीक्षते। नगशाखाग्रगः पापस्तस्याहं भृशमुद्विजे॥
en: There that wretched owl with restless looks and dreadful cries is seeing me from the branch of that tree! I am stricken with great fear.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्तु मातङ्गमुवाच परिसान्त्वयन्। क्षुधितोऽहं गतप्राणो हरिष्यामि श्वजाघनीम्॥
en: Conciliating the Chandala, Vishvamitra said, I am greatly hungry and about to die of starvation. I wise to take away that haunch of dog's meat.

sa: कोष्ठकीकृत्य चाप्येनं परिक्षिप्य च सर्वशः। शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्जघ्नुर्युद्धपारं तितीर्षवः॥
en: Desirous of terminating the hostilities, the Pandavas, forming a wall, encircled Shakuni on all sides and began to strike him with various kinds of weapons.

sa: धृतमैश्वर्यमेव च। बलेन यश्च संयुक्तः सदा पञ्चविधात्मकः॥
en: God gave both prosperity and the rod of punishment to the king who is possessed of strength and who is a combination of five expedients.

sa: स्वमाश्रमपद् पुण्यमाजगाम पतत्रिवत्। प्रविशन्नेव चापश्यजैगीषव्यं स देवलः॥
en: He repaired to his own sacred hermitage very quickly, like a winged insect. As soon as he entered his abode he beheld Jaigishavya seated there.

sa: नाराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु वस्तव्यमिति रोचये। नाराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु हव्यमग्निर्वहत्युत॥
en: No one should live in kingdoms torn by anarchy. Agni does not carry the libations that are poured upon him in kingdoms where anarchy reigns.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ साश्वसूतध्वजरथं शल्यं प्राच्छादयच्छरैः।
en: Taking up another bow, that great carwarrior, viz., the son of Dharma, covered Shalya, his horses and driver and standard and car, with many arrows.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजपदानुगान्॥ सहितानभ्यवर्तन्त गुल्ममास्थाय मध्यमम्।
en: Meanwhile beholding in that battle the followers of the Madra king assailing them unitedly the Pandavas proceeded against thein, arraying themselves in the Madhyama from.

sa: सर्वभूतेष्वनुक्रोशं कुर्वतस्तस्य भारत। आनृशंस्यप्रवृत्तस्य सर्वावस्थं पदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, who shows mercy towards all creatures and abstains entirely from cruelty, O Bharata, attains to the object of all the modes of life.

sa: ततः सुहृद्बलं लब्ध्वा मन्त्रयित्वा सुमन्त्रिभिः॥ आन्तरैर्भेदयित्वारीन् बिल्वं बिल्वेन भेदय। परैर्वा संविदं कृत्वा बलमप्यस्य घातय॥
en: Having then mustered a large force and held consultations with good ministers, do you create dissensions among your enemies, and setting them against one another, break them all like a person breaking a Vilva with a Vilva. Or, making peace with the enemies of your foe, destroy the latter's power.

sa: तस्मै विनिश्चितार्थाय परिपृष्टोऽर्थनिश्चयम्! उवाच ब्राह्मणो वाक्यमिदं हेतुमदुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus accosted about the truths of the science of Profit, the twice-born one said the following reasonable words to that king for explaining those truths.

sa: चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य ब्राह्मणस्य विशाम्पते। भैक्षचर्यास्वधीकारः प्रशस्त इह मोक्षिणः॥
en: The Brahmana, O king, who is desirous of liberation, is is competent to adopt the mendicant's life after having gone through the mode called Brahmacharya.

sa: शृणु नामानि चाप्येषां येऽन्ये स्कन्दस्य सैनिकाः।।५५ विविधायुधसम्पन्नाश्चित्राभरणभूषिताः।
en: Listen now to the names of those other warriors armed with various weapons and clad in diverse kind of robes and ornaments, that Skanda got.

sa: चापवेगबलोद्धृतान् मार्गणान् वृष्णिसिंहयोः। आकाशे समपश्याम पतङ्गानिव शीघ्रगान्॥
en: The arrows discharged forcibly from the bows of the two Vrishni heroes were seen by us in the sky to resemble fights of quickcoursing insects.

sa: त्रिभिरंशैरधर्मस्तु लोकानाक्रम्य तिष्ठति। तामसं युगमासाद्य तदा भरतसत्तम॥ चतुर्थांशेनधर्मस्तु मनुष्यानुपतिष्ठति। आयुर्वीर्यमथो बुद्धिर्बलं तेजश्च पाण्डव॥ मनुष्याणामनुयुगं ह्रसतीति निबोध मे। राजानो ब्राह्मणा वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव युधिष्ठिर॥ व्याजैर्धर्म चरिष्यन्तिधर्मवैतंसिका नराः। सत्यं संक्षेप्स्यते लोके नरैः पण्डितमानिभिः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, in the dark age (Kali) virtue being mixed with three parts of sin lives by the side of men. Accordingly virtue is said to wait upon men with only fourth part remaining. O Yudhishthira, know that the period of life, the energy, the intellect and the physical strength of men (gradually) decrease in every Yuga. O Yudhishthira, the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas, the Vaishyas and Shudras will practise morality and virtue with deceit and men in general will deceive their fellow men by spreading the (false) net of virtue. Men with false pride of learning by their acts will make truth concealed.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज शोणितौघपरिप्लुतः। वसन्ते पुष्पशबलो रक्ताशोक इवाबभौ॥
en: That hero (Bhishma) thus deeply pierced, O mighty monarch, and bathed in copiously flowering blood, appeared beautiful like flowering red Ashoka tree in the spring.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रमैक्ष्वाकः पीडितोऽत्र प्रतिज्ञया। सवाष्पमतिनिःश्वस्य जगादेदं पुनर्वचः॥
en: Then that descendant of Ikṣvāku afflicted because of his promise, sighing and his heart filled with the vapour begot of sorrow, again addressed Sumantra, saying.

sa: गुरौ चानृतिके पापे कृतघ्ने ग्रामयाजके। वेदविक्रयिणे दत्तं तथा वृषलयाजके॥ ब्रह्मबन्धुषु यद् दत्तं यद् दत्तं वृषलीपतौ। स्त्रीजनेषु च यद् दत्तं व्यालग्राहे तथैव च॥ परिचारकेषु यद् दत्तं वृथा दानानि षोडश।
en: The gift to an untruthful man, to one who officiates at sacrifices performed by all classes of people residing in a village, to one that sells the Vedas to a Brahmana who cooks for a Shudra, to one who is by birth a Brahmana, but who does not perform the duties of his order, is all in vain. The gift to one who has married a girl already in her puberty, to a woman, to one who sports with a snake and to one who is engaged in minimal services, is also in vain. These are the sixteen useless charities.

sa: तथैव कौरवो युद्धे शैनेयं युद्धदुर्मदम्। दशभिर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैरविध्यत भुजान्तरे॥
en: Similarly, the descendant of Kuru (i.e. Bhurij, in (that) engagement, quickly pierced the grandson of Sini invincible in battle, in the chest, with ten darts.

sa: अनया चित्रया वाचा त्रिस्थानव्यञ्जनस्थया। कस्य नाराध्यते चित्तमुद्यतासेररेरपि॥
en: Whose heart is not moved by these wonderful words, proceeding (from heart, throat and brain)? Even an enemy, who has his sword uplifted, (is moved).

sa: दुर्योधनसमादिष्टाः कुञ्जरैः पर्वतोपमैः। प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च कलिङ्गप्रमुखा नृपाः॥
en: Commanded by Duryodhana, the easterners, the southerners and other kings hearded by the ruler of the Kalingas surrounded Arjuna with their elephants huge as hills.

sa: ततो रथसहस्रेण हयानामयुतेन च। कोष्ठकीकृत्य बीभत्सुं प्रहृष्टमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Surrounding him on all sides as within a cage by means of a thousand cars and ten thousand horse, those brave warriors expressed their joy.

sa: आचकर्षतुरन्योन्यं मुष्टिभिश्चापि जघ्नतुः। ततश्चटचटाशब्दः सुघोरो ह्यभवत् तयोः॥
en: As they fought each other with blows hard as the clash of two pieces of stones, the arena rang with the sound of their combat.

sa: भीमसेनोऽथ संक्रुद्धस्तस्य सैन्यं दुरासदम्। नाराचैर्विमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्दिशः प्राद्रावयद् बली॥
en: Worked up with anger the powerful Bhimasena began to rout your army, whom it is so difficult to vanquish, with his sharp and polished arrows.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम हार्दिक्यस्य पराक्रमम्। यदेनं सहिताः पार्था नातिचक्रमुराहवे॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Hridika's son inasmuch as the united divisions of the Parthas were unable to bear him down in battle.

sa: विलेपुरेवं दीनास्ता राक्षसाधिपयोषितः। कुरर्य इव दुःखार्ता बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः॥
en: Thus wept piteously the wives of the lord of Rakşasas like to so many she-elephants-rendered poorly, stricken with grief and with tears in their eyes.

sa: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः। द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनाथ महात्मनः॥
en: O high-souled one, I have been highly favoured and blessed by beholding you. I shall come again some other time to free myself from sins.

sa: अप्लवेऽम्भसि मग्नानामप्रतिष्ठे निमज्जताम्। पाञ्चाली पाण्डुपुत्राणां नौरेषा पारगाभवत्॥
en: The sons of Pandu were sinking boatless in an ocean of distress, this Panchali, becoming a boat to them, brought them safely to the shore.

sa: स ददर्श ततः सालमविदूरे हरीश्वरः। सुपुष्पमीषत्पत्राढ्यं भ्रमरैरुपशोभितम्॥
en: And hard by that lord of monkeys discovered a Sāla tree, bearing a few beautiful blossoms, with its wealth of foliage, decked by black bees.

sa: वने प्रवाजितान् पार्थान् यदाऽऽयान्मधुसूदनः। महता बलचक्रेण परराष्ट्रावमर्दिना॥ केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। राजानश्चान्वयुः पार्थान् बहवोऽन्येऽनुयायिनः॥
en: When the slayer of Madhu came to the sons of Pritha wandering in exile in the forest with a large army capable of subjugating the kingdom of the enemies and when Kaikeya, Dhrishtaketu, Dhrishtadyumna of the race of Prishata and many other kings followed them to the sons of Pritha.

sa: तानाह सर्वानृषिमुख्यानगस्त्यः केनादत्तं पुष्करं सुजातम्। युष्माशङ्के पुष्करं दीयतां मे न वै भवन्तो हर्तुमर्हन्ति पद्मम्॥
en: The foremost of Rishis, Agastya, addressing them all, said, Who has taken away good stalks which I had extracted and deposited here? I suspect some one amongst you must have taken them. Let him who has taken them away return them to me. You should not thus misappropriate my stalks.

sa: तं कुमारमृषिर्दृष्ट्वा कर्म चास्यातिमानुषम्॥ समयो यौवराज्यायेत्यब्रवीच शकुन्तलाम्।
en: Seeing the extraordinary acts of the boy, the Rishi (Kanva) told Shakuntala that the time had come when he should be installed as the heir-apparent.

sa: अतिथीन् पूजयामास वन्येन हविषा विभुः। शिलोच्छवृत्तिमास्थाय शेषान्नकृतभोजनः॥
en: The illustrious king entertained the guests and strangers with fruits of the forest and ghee. He supported himself by eating only the scattered corn seeds.

sa: यथा नागपदेऽन्यानि पदानि पदगामिनाम्। सर्वाण्येवापिधीयन्ते पदजातानि कौञ्जरे॥
en: As the foot-prints of all other creatures moving upon legs are engulfed within those of elephants, likewise all ranks and conditions are absorbed within Yoga.

sa: सर्ववित् सर्वभूतेषु विन्दत्यात्मानमात्मनि। एकधा बहुधा चैव विकुर्वाणस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Understanding all things, he sees his self, with self, in all creatures, sometimes as one and sometimes as various, changing form from time to time.

sa: रत्नैः स्त्रीभिस्तथा गोभिर्धनैर्बहुविधैरपि। निदर्शनैश्च बहुभिः कुण्डलेप्सुः पुरन्दरः॥
en: And you will try to appease Purandara, desirous of getting the ear-rings, by offering gems, women, cows, various sorts of riches and by citing precedents.

sa: हतारोहास्तथा नागाश्छिन्नहस्तास्तथापरे॥ सर्वं पार्थमयं लोकमपश्यन् वै भयार्दिताः।
