en: Some elephants whose riders had been killed and others whose trunks had been cut off, stricken with fear, saw the entire universe full of Partha.

sa: कुड्मलाम्बुरुहाकारौ तव सुभ्रु पयोधरौ। कामप्रतोदाविव मां तुदतश्चारुहासिनि॥
en: Your breasts, O you of fair eye-brows, resemble lotus-buds in shape; like the whips of Kama they are afflicting me, O you of pleasant smiles.

sa: इत्युक्तः पुरुषश्रेष्ठस्तदा कृष्णेन धीमता। प्रोवाच वृष्णिशार्दूलमेवमेतदिति प्रभो॥
en: Thus answered by the intelligent Krishna, that foremost of men, viz., kings, Yudhishthira, said to the chief of the Vrishnis that it was even SO.

sa: सरो मानसमासाद्य हाटकानभितः प्रभुः। गन्धर्वरक्षितं देशमजयत् पाण्डवस्ततः॥
en: Having arrived at the Manasa (lake), the lord Pandava (Arjuna) conquered the regions, ruled by the Gandharvas the regions that lay around the Hataka countries.

sa: क्रूराय कर्मणे युक्तश्चिकीर्षुः कर्म दुष्करम्। अवाकिरच्छरशतैर्भारद्वाजं महारथम्॥
en: Engaged in a heartless act and attempting to accomplish a difficult one, he covered the mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja, with an arrowy down-pour.

sa: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षार्थैः समासव्यासकीर्तनैः। तथा भारतसूर्येण नृणां विनिहतं तमः॥
en: As the sun drives away the darkness, so does this Bharata, by its discourses on Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha, drive the ignorance of men.

sa: ब्रह्मधर्मोत्तरे राज्ये शान्तनुर्विनयात्मवान्। समं शशास भूतानि कामरागविवर्जितः॥
en: The virtue of kindness reigned in the kingdom of Shantanu, who himself was full of mercy and free from anger. He equally protected all creatures.

sa: ततः शल्यो महावीरो मद्रराजो महाबलः। तदप्यारोप्यमाणस्तु जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्॥
en: Then in attempting to string the bow the great hero Shalya, the greatly powerful king of Madra, also fell upon his knees on the ground.

sa: गृहीतखड्गचर्माणस्ततो भूयः प्रहारिणः। त्सरुमार्गान् यथोद्दिष्टांश्चेसः सर्वासु भूमिषु॥
en: They took up their swords and buckles and began to attack one another and to walk around the arena displaying various modes of sword's play.

sa: एनमासाद्य राजानः समृद्धबलवाहनाः। विनाशमुपयास्यन्ति शलभा इव पावकम्॥
en: The kings who are rich in their armies and troops will meet with destruction at the hand of your son like insects in the fire.

sa: विहितं कामचाराणां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्। शेषमन्यन्मनुष्याणा कर्मचारेषु वै स्मृतम्॥
en: Therefore, if any man out of greed wander during those moments and come near us, both we, (the Gandharvas) and the Rakshasas kill those fools.

sa: ध्रुवमस्मत्सहायास्ते भविष्यन्ति प्रधानतः। अर्थवर्गः सहामात्यो मत्संस्थोऽद्य महीपते॥
en: Thus they would surely side with us for this proof of our power. O king, the ministers and the treasury are now under our control.

sa: अनन्तरं महाविप्रो गौतमः प्रत्यपूरयत्। वसिष्ठोऽपि महातेजा इन्द्रयज्ञमथाकरोत्॥
en: After the departure of Vasiştha the great Gautama engaged in the satisfaction of Vasist ha's duties. And the high-souled Vasistha too engaged in Indra's sacrifice.

sa: धर्मो विदुररूपेण शापात् तस्य महात्मनः। माण्डव्यस्यार्थतत्वज्ञः कामक्रोधविवर्जितः॥
en: The God of Justice was thus bom as Vidura in consequence of the curse of the Rishi Mandavya. He was free from desire and anger.

sa: स मृगान् महिषांश्चैव विनिघ्नन् राजसत्तमः। गङ्गामनुचचारैकः सिद्धचारणसेविताम्॥
en: That best of kings many deer and buffaloes. Wandering along the banks of the Ganges, he came upon a place frequented by Siddhas and Charanas.

sa: तेषामेवंप्रवृत्तानां सर्वेषामसुरद्विषाम्। सम्भूय सर्वैरस्माभिः कार्यः सर्वात्मना वधः॥
en: "Engaged in such works, they are the enemies of the Asuras. Therefore, the duty of all of us is to muster together and exterminate them."

sa: उपतस्थुर्महात्मानं गन्धर्वाप्सरसो नृपम्। राजोपरिचरेत्येवं नाम तस्याथ विश्रुतम्॥
en: The Gandharvas and Apsaras came to adore that illustrious man. And because he moved through the upper regions (in his car), he was called Uparichara.

sa: एते विचित्रवीर्यस्य क्षेत्रे द्वैपायनादपि। जज्ञिरे देवगर्भाभाः कुरुवंशविवर्धनाः॥
en: Thus were begotten on the field (wives) of Vichitravirya by Dvaipayana three sons, as effulgent as the celestial children, the expanders of the Kuru race.

sa: जनमेजयस्तु राजर्षिर्दृष्ट्वा तमृषिमागतम्। सगणोऽभ्युद्ययौ तूर्णं प्रीत्या भरतसत्तमः॥
en: The best of the Bharata race, the royal sage Janamejaya, seeing the Rishi approaching, advanced quickly in great joy with all his relatives and followers.

sa: तलेनाहन्यमानौ तु अन्योन्यं कृतवीक्षणौ। सिंहाविव सुसंक्रुद्धावाकृष्याकृष्य युध्यताम्॥
en: Becoming angry at each other's blow they dragged and pushed each other, and they fought on, looking fiercely at each other like two angry lions.

sa: संभवश्चैव कृष्णाया धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चैव ह। ब्राह्मणात्समुपश्रुत्य व्यासवाक्यप्रचोदिताः॥
en: The wonderful births of Krishnaa (Draupadi) and Drishtadyumna; hearing from a Brahmana the news of the Svayamvara and in obedience to the request of Vyasa.

sa: यदुस्तु जनयामास यातुधानान्सहस्रशः। पुरे क्रौञ्चवने दुर्गे राजवंशबहिष्कृते॥
en: Yadu begot thousands and thousands of Räkşasas and being degraded from the royal family reigned in a city named Krauñcavana, hard to be got at.

sa: न शय्यासनभोगेषु रतिं विन्दति कर्हिचित्। भ्रातृशोकसमाविष्टस्तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्॥
en: He derived no pleasure in the comforts of his beds, seats and luxuries. Afflicted with the loss of his brother, he continually brooded over it.

sa: जातमात्रश्च यः सद्य इष्ट्या देहमवीवृधत्। वेदांश्चाधिजगे साङ्गान्सेतिहासान्महायशाः॥
en: As soon as born, the illustrious man developed his body by his will alone and mastered the Vedas and the Vedangas and all the histories.

sa: स समाजजन: सर्वो निश्चल: स्थिरलोचनः। कोऽयमित्यागतक्षोभः कौतूहलपरोऽभवत्॥
en: The entire assembly of people remain emotionless and stared in steadfast gaze. They were filled with great curiously and asked one another, "Who is he?"

sa: सोऽब्रवीन्मेघगम्भीरस्वरेण वदतां वरः। भ्राता भ्रातरमज्ञातं सावित्रः पाकशासनिम्॥
en: That foremost of eloquent men, the son of the sun, (Karna) in a voice deep as the roars of clouds, addressed his unknown brother thus-

sa: ततो वर्षसहस्राणि ययातिरपराजितः। स्थितः स नृपशार्दूल: शार्दूलसमविक्रमः॥
en: Even when one thousand years had thus passed away, Yayati, the best of kings, the invincible hero, remained as strong and powerful as a tiger.

sa: ददानीति प्रतिज्ञाते फाल्गुनेनाब्रवीद् गुरुः। युद्धेऽहं प्रतियोद्धव्यो युध्यमानस्त्वयानघ॥
en: Falguni (Arjuna) promised to the preceptor "To give (the Dakshina)." Drona said, O sinless one, you must fight with me when I fight with you.'

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं रामो विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः॥ श्वाप्यगच्छन्महातेजा यत एवागतस्ततः।
en: Hearing the words of the dog, the eyes of the effulgent Rāma were expanded with surprise. The dog went back from where it had come.

sa: सम्भोगस्नेहचातुर्यैर्हावभावसमन्वितैः। राजानं रमयामास यथा रेमे तथैव सः॥
en: She pleased the king with her attractiveness and love, with her affection and wits, her music and dance and king was exceedingly pleased with her.

sa: सनत्कुमारस्तं राजन् ब्रह्मलोकादुपेत्य ह॥ अनुदर्श ततश्चक्रे प्रत्यगृह्णान्न चाप्यसौ। ततो महर्षिभिः क्रुद्धैः सद्यः शप्तो व्यनश्यत॥
en: Seeing this, Sanatkumar came from the region of Brahma and gave him good counsel, which he did not accept. Thereupon, the wrath of the great Rishis was excited and the king, who was intoxicated with the pride of power and who lost his reason, was immediately killed by their curse.

sa: जरामृत्युभयव्याधिभावाभावविनिश्चयः। विविधस्य च धर्मस्य ह्याश्रमाणां च लक्षणम्॥
en: And it contains the nature of decay, death, fear, disease existence and non-existence; a description of creeds and the account of various modes of life.

sa: भक्ष्यमाल्यापणानां च ददृशुः श्रियमुत्तमाम्। स्फीतां सर्वगुणोपेतां सर्वकामसमृद्धिनीम्॥
en: They saw many beautiful shops, full of v...ious eataoles and garlands, every shop swelling with every article and every wealth that man can ever desire.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वाऽन्वगच्छत्तं ततो दानवसूदनः। देवदेवं महात्मानं योगिनामीश्वरं हरिम्॥
en: "Be it so." said the destroyer of the Danavas and he went to Hari, the god of gods, the great Soul, the lord of Yogis.

sa: अतिथीनागतान् देवान् दैत्यान् नागांस्तथा द्विजान्। यक्षान् सुपर्णान् कालेयान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥ महाभागानमितधीब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। दयावान् सर्वभूतेषु यथार्ह प्रतिपद्यते॥ प्रतिगृह्य तु विश्वात्मा सवयम्भूरमितद्युतिः। सान्त्वमानार्थसम्भोगैर्युनक्ति मनुजाधिप॥
en: O king of men, the immeasurably intelligent Brahma, the Grandsire of all created things, the self-reacted Supreme Deity of immeasurable effulgence, is ever kind equally on all creatures, honours each as each deserves and gratifies with sweet speech gifts of wealth and other enjoyable things all those Devas, Daityas, the Nagas, the Yakshas, the Brahmanas, the birds, the Kaleyas, the Gandharvas, the Apsaras and all other illustrious beings that come to him as his guests.

sa: बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद् वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति। कार्णं वेदमिमं विद्वाञ्च्छ्रावयित्वार्थमश्नुते॥
en: But the Veda is afraid of men of little learning, lest they hurt it. The learned man. are who recites this Veda, (Bharata) gains advantage.

sa: पौष्यं तत्र च पौलोममास्तीकं चादितः स्मृतम्। विचित्रार्थपदाख्यानमनेकसमयान्वितम्॥
en: There are three Parvas in the beginning (of this great work), namely Paushya, Pauloma and Astika, which contain many wonderful dictions and descriptions and senses.

sa: यत्रार्जुनो द्वारवतीमेत्य वृष्णिविनाकृताम्। दृष्ट्वा विषादमगमत्परां चार्तिं नरर्षभः॥
en: Then is described the arrival of Arjuna, the foremost of men, at Dwarka and his sorrow and affliction seeing the city destitute of the Vrishnis.

sa: तत्र चासीदमेयात्मा विद्युदग्निसमप्रभः। भौमनः सुमहावीर्यः सोमस्य परिरक्षिता॥
en: Amongst those that were guarding the Soma Bhaumana (Vishvakarma) of matchless strength and of great energy. He was as effulgent as the lightning and fire.

sa: कच्चिदभ्यवहार्याणि गात्रसंस्पर्शनानि च। प्रेयाणि च महाराज रक्षन्त्यनुमतास्तव॥
en: O great king, you have surely appointed trusted servants to look after the food you eat, the robes you wear and the perfume you use.

sa: तं चाप्रतिस्थः श्रीमानाश्रमं प्रत्यपद्यत। देवलोकप्रतीकाशं सर्वतः सुमनोहरम्॥
en: Thereupon, the king, whose chariot no foe could obstruct, entered that charming hermitage, exceedingly beautiful all over and which was like the region of heaven.

sa: तेषामाकारभावज्ञः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। द्वैपायनवचः कृत्स्नं सस्मार मनुजर्षभः॥
en: Seeing their demeanour and knowing what was passing through their minds, that best of men, the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira recollected the words of Dvaipayana.

sa: सर्वं विस्तरशस्तात भवाञ्छंसितुमर्हति। सर्पसत्रविधानज्ञविज्ञेयाः के च सूतज॥
en: O child, you should describe all this in detail, so that, O Sauti, we may know who were acquainted with the rituals of the Snakesacrifice.

sa: श्रुत्वा गुणानहं तस्यां सभायाः पाण्डवर्षभ। दर्शनेप्सुस्तथा राजन्नादित्यमिदमब्रवम्॥
en: O best of the Pandavas, hearing the merits of that Sabha, I became desirous of seeing it. O king, I then spoke thus to Aditya.

sa: जरासंधात्मजश्चैव सहदेवो महामनाः। निर्ययौ सजनामात्यः पुरस्कृत्यः पुरोहितम्॥
en: The son of Jarasandha, the high-minded Sahadeva, came out there with his relatives and his ministers, his priest being at the head of the procession.

sa: अश्विनौ गुह्यकान्विद्धि सर्वोषध्यस्तथा पशून्। एते देवगणा राजन्कीर्तितास्तेऽनुपूर्वशः॥४
en: The Ashvinis, all annual plants and all beasts were counted among the Guhyakas. O king, these are the Ganas of the celestials, narrated to you.

sa: यथैव भगवान्रुद्रो विध्वा यज्ञमृगं दिवि। अन्वगच्छद्धनुष्पाणि: पर्यन्वेष्टुमितस्ततः॥
en: He searched for it in the forest here and there, as Rudra did in heaven for the sacrificial deer which was pierced with his arrow.

sa: अन्तःपुरवनोद्याने पर्वतेषु वनेषु च। यथेप्सितेषु देशेषु विजह्रातेऽमराविव॥
en: Like the immortals they roamed in profuse pleasure and amusement in houses, in woods, in gardens, in forests and on hills, nay wherever they liked.

sa: ततः शक्रोऽतिसंक्रुद्धस्त्रिदशानां महेश्वरः। पाण्डुरं गजमास्थाय तावुभौ समुपाद्रवत्॥ वेगेनाशनिमादाय वज्रमस्त्रं च सोऽसृजत्। हतावेताविति प्राह सुरानसुरसूदनः॥
en: Then the lord of the celestial Indra, riding on him white elephant, rushed upon the two heroes and speedily taking up his irresistible thunder bolt he hurled it with great force. The slayer of the Asuras (Indra) said to the celestial, “ These ter@ (Krishna and Arjuna) are already killed."

sa: इमेऽष्टौ वसवो देवा महाभागा महौजसः। वसिष्ठशापदोषेण मानुषत्वमुपागताः॥
en: These sons were the eight celestials, the illustrious and greatly effulgent Vasus. They had to assume human form in consequence of the curse of Vasistha.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसंकाशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम्। एकान्त ऋषिसंवातश्चकार उटजाशुभान्॥
en: And beholding this wonderful sacrifice resembling that of the celestials, his followers, the Rşis, made charming cottages in a solitary corner and at no distance.

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः। यथार्ह मानयामास पौरजानपदानपि॥
en: Then the dweller of Kausalya's joy, (Pandu), worshipped the feet of his father (uncle) Bhishma and then saluted the citizens and others as each deserved.

sa: पूर्वजं नकुलेत्येवं सहदेवेति चापरम्। माद्रीपुत्रावकथयंस्ते विप्राः प्रीतमानसाः॥
en: The first birth of the twins among Madri's sons was named Nakula and the next one Sahadeva. The Brahmanas with much pleasure named them thus.

sa: चतुर्विधं महीपाल निर्दहत्याशु तेजसा। जरायुजाण्डजस्वेदजोद्भिज्जं च नराधिप॥
en: He then consumes with his energy, O king, without any loss of time, the four sorts of created beings, viz., viviparous, oviparious, filth-born, and vegetable.

sa: हत्वा साध्वी च नारी च व्यसनित्वाच्च वासिताम्। भर्तव्यत्वेन भार्यां च को न मां तारयिष्यति॥
en: Alas, I have killed a woman,-a woman who is again my wife-one, who, on account of her sharing her husband's misfortunes passed by the name of Vasita, one, who was called Bharya owing to my obligation for maintaining her, Who is there who can save me from this sin ?

sa: आत्मैवादौ नियन्तव्यो दुष्कृतं संनियच्छता। दण्डयेच्च महादण्डैरपि बन्धूननन्तरान्॥
en: The king should first control his own self if he mean to control other offenders. He should punish sufficiently even his friends and near relatives.

sa: वारिधारासमूहेन सम्प्रविष्टः शतक्रतुः। क्षणेन पूरयामास सलिलेन वसुन्धराम्॥
en: The god of a hundred sacrifices having entered the clouds with a profuse supply of rain, the Earth became flooded with water in a moment.

sa: तथा कामकृतं नास्य विहिंसैवानुकर्षति। इत्याहुर्ब्रह्मशास्त्रज्ञा ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: A sin, however, however, that is committed knowingly is never repaired by righteousness. Thus the twice-born Brahmavadins who are conversant with the scriptures of Brahman.

sa: ततस्तमभ्यगाद् राजन् राजधर्मा खगोत्तमः। स्वागतेनाभिनन्दंश्च गौतमं मित्रवत्सलः॥
en: While Gautama was taking rest there, that best of birds, viz., Rajadharman, O king, came there. Devoted to friends, he gladdened Gautama by welcoming him.

sa: यथोपदिष्टं मेधावी दर्भा_दि यथातथम्। हव्यकव्यविधिं कृत्स्नमुक्तं तेन तपस्विना॥ ऋषिणा पितृकार्यं च स च धर्मपथे स्थितः। पितृकार्यं कृते चापि विसृष्टः स जगाम ह॥ अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य स तप्यन् शूद्रतापसः। वने पञ्चत्वमगमत् सुकृतेन च तेन वै॥ अजायत महाराजवंशे स च महाद्युतिः। तथैव स ऋषिस्तात कालधर्ममवाप ह॥
en: Endued with great intelligence, and practising righteousness, the Shudra received every direction, about the Sraddha, as laid down in the ordinance, from that Rishi gifted with penances, marking the manner of spreading the Kusha grass, and placing the Arghyas, and as regards the rites to be observed in the matter of the libations to be poured and the food to be offered. After the rites in honour of the Pitris had been finished, the Rishi, was sent away the Shudra, whercupon he returned to his own abode. After a long time, the whole of which he passed practising such penances and vows, the Shudra ascetic died in the those woods. On account of I the merit he acquired by those practices, the Shudra, in his next life, was born in the family of a great king, and in time became possessed of grea

sa: पश्यन्नपि यथा लक्ष्म जगत् सोमे न विन्दति। एवमस्ति न चोत्पन्नं न च तन्न परायणम्॥
en: People see the world reflected on the inoon's disc in the shape of spots. Though seeing, they do not know that it is the world that is so reflected there. Such is the knowledge of the Soul. That knowledge must come of itself. The Soul depends upon the Soul itself.

sa: पितरं सम्परित्यज्य जगाम मुनिसत्तमः। कैलासपृष्ठं विपुलं सिद्धसंघनिषेवितम्॥
en: Leaving his father, that foremost of Rishis then went to the spacious breast, of Kailasa which was inhabited by numbers of ascetics crowned with success.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा सा महादेवमगच्छच्छरणं किला निराहारा भयादत्रेस्रीणि वर्षशतान्यपि॥
en: Having said these words, she sought the protection of Mahadeva. Through fear of her husband Atri, she passed three hundred years, abstaining from all food.

sa: शिबिरौशीनरोऽङ्गानि सुतं च प्रियमौरसम्। ब्राह्मणार्थमुपाहृत्य नाकपृष्ठमितो गतः॥
en: Ushinara's son Shivi, having given away his own limbs and his dear son for the sake of a Brahmana, ascended to heaven from this world.

sa: यस्मादगाधादव्यक्तादुत्तीर्णस्त्वं सनातनात्। तस्मात् त्वं विरजाश्चैव वितमस्कश्च पार्थिव॥
en: Since you, O king, have been freed from that eternal and limitless Ocean of Ignorance, you have, therefore, become freed from Darkness and also Ignorance.

sa: स कदाचिन्महेष्वास देवराजालयं गतः। सत्कृतश्च महेन्द्रेण प्रत्यासन्नगतोऽभवत्॥
en: Once upon a time he went to the abode of Indra. Duly honoured by the king of the gods, he sat close to his host.

sa: धर्मशीलं गुणोपेतं पापमित्यवगच्छति। आत्मशीलप्रमाणेन न विश्वसिति कस्यचित्॥
en: Such a man considers a virtuous and qualified person as a pest, and thinking every one else to be like himself never trusts any one.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच लोककार्यगती: सर्वास्त्वं चिन्तय यथाविधि। धाता त्वं सर्वभूतानां त्वं प्रभुर्जगतो गुरुः॥ त्वय्यावेशितभारोऽहं धृति प्राप्स्याम्यथाजसा।
en: The Holy One said Do you, O Brahman, duly think of the courses of acts which creatures should follow. You are the great ordainer of all created Beings, You are the Master and the Lord of the universe. Placing this burthen on you I shall soon be free from anxiety.

sa: सावरुद्य विमानाग्रादङ्गनानामनुत्तमा। अभ्यागच्छत् त्रिलोकेशं देवर्षि चापि नारदम्॥
en: Getting down from her foremost of cars, that peerless lady began to approach towards the lord of the three worlds and the celestial Rishi Narada.

sa: प्राप्नुयाद् विषयांश्चैव पुनश्चोग्रं तपश्चरेत्। संक्षिपेच्च पुनस्तात सूर्यस्तेजोगुणानिव॥
en: Some amongst them enjoy objects of the and again practise the austerest penances, and once again, like the Sun withdraw themselves from such penances. senses

sa: ततोऽपयत चीराणि सूक्ष्माणि द्विजसत्तमः। पार्श्वतोऽभ्याशतो न्यस्तान्यथ निर्वेदमागतः॥
en: The Brahinana then saw scattered around him many fine fabrics of cloth. Without caring for them at all, the Brahmana came to disrelish the world.

sa: सेयं भावात्मिका भावांस्त्रीनेतानतिवर्तते। सरितां सागरो भर्ता महावेलामिवोर्मिमान्॥
en: Sometimes the Intelligence which is made up of the three qualities, transcends them (by Yoga), like the Ocean with his surges, transgressing his high continents.

sa: छागशार्दूलरूपश्च अनेकमृगरूपधृक्। अण्डजानां च दिव्यानां वपुर्धारयते भवः॥
en: He assumes the forms of also goats and pards and various other animals. Bhava assumes the forins of various kinds of birds of beautiful plumage.

sa: कृष्णद्वैपायनं व्यासं विद्धि नारायणं भुवि। को ह्यन्यः पुरुषव्याघ्र महाभारतकृद् भवेत्॥ धर्मान्नानाविधांश्चैव को ब्रूयात्तमृते प्रभुम्॥
en: Know that the Island-born Krishna, otherwise called Vyasa, is Narayana on Earth. Who else than he, O foremost of kings, could compile such a work as the Mahabharata? Who else than that powerful Rishi could describe the diverse kinds of duties and religion for the। observance and adoption of men.

sa: एतदुन्मेषमात्रेण विनष्टं स्थाणु जङ्गमम्। कूर्मपृष्ठसमा भूमिर्भवत्यथ समन्ततः॥
en: Within, the twinkling of the eye all mobile and immobile creatures being thus destroyed, the Earth becomes on all sides, bare as a tortoise shell.

sa: इषुकारो नरः कश्चिदिषावासक्तमानसः। समीपेनापि गच्छन्तं राजानं नावबुद्धवान्॥
en: A certain shaft-maker busy with his work, was so deeply engrossed with it that he did not notice the king who was passing by him.

sa: आतपत्रेण सदृशे शिरसी देवयोस्तयोः। एवं लक्षणसम्पन्नौ महापुरुषसंज्ञितौ॥
en: The heads of those two gods were large and round, resembling open umbrellas. Endued with these marks, they were certainly very superior persons in appearance.

sa: सम्यनिदर्शनं नाम प्रत्यक्षं प्रकृतेस्तथा। गुणतत्त्वान्यथैतानि निर्गुणोऽन्यस्तथा भवेत्॥
en: Indeed, as men whose understandings are subject to error directly perceive all objects of the senses, so men freed from error have directly known Brahma.

sa: पिशाचा राक्षसाः प्रेता विविधा म्लेच्छजातयः। प्रणष्टज्ञानविज्ञाना: स्वच्छन्दाचारचेष्टिताः॥
en: Destitute of the light of knowledge, living a loose life of dissolution they are born as Pishas and Rakshasas and Ghosts, and as Mleccha tribes.

sa: एवं शक्रेण संप्राप्ता ब्रह्मवध्या जनाधिप। पितामहमनुज्ञाप्य सोऽश्वमेधमकल्पयत्॥
en: It was thus, O king, that Indra had become attacked by that dreadful sin. With the Grandfather's permission Indra then resolved to celebrate a Horse-sacrifice.

sa: सर्वे सम्मतमैश्वर्यमीश्वराः प्रतिपेदिरे॥ न चैश्वर्यमदस्तेषां भूतपूर्वो महात्मनाम्।
en: Endued with great might, all of them had gained the highest prosperity and affluence. But none of those great kings lead the pride of sovereignty.

sa: यथा चन्द्रार्कनिर्मुक्तः स राहु!पलभ्यते। तद्वच्छरीरनिर्मुक्तः शरीरी नोपलभ्यते॥
en: When freed from the sun or the moon, Rahu is no longer seen. Likewise the Soul, freed from the body, can no longer be seen.

sa: अपरिज्ञातपूर्वाश्च गणपूर्वाश्च भारत। पुत्रिकापूर्वपुत्राश्च श्राद्धे नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas whose antecedents are not known or are vile, and they who are Putrika-putras, should not, O king, be invited on occasions of Shraddhas.

sa: नाग उवाच अनुक्त्वा हृद्गतं कार्यं क्वेदानीं प्रस्थितौ भवान्। उच्यदां द्विज यत् कार्यं यदर्थं त्वमिहागतः॥
en: The Naga said The object that brought you here is still in your mind, for you have not as yet given it out to me. Where then will you go? Tell me, O twice-born one, what should be done by me, and what that object is which brought you here.

sa: समग्रैस्त्रिदशैस्तत्र इष्टमासीद् द्विजर्षभ। योन्द्रातिक्रमं चक्रे मान्धाता राजसत्तमः॥
en: There, in that region, all the gods, asscmbled a grand sacrifice. There the foremost of earthly kings, Mandhatri, defeated Indra, the king of the gods.

sa: संप्राप्तमवमानं यस्तेजसा न प्रमार्जति। कस्तस्य पौरुषेणार्थो महताप्यल्पचेतसः॥
en: What is the use of his manliness, who when insulted, cannot remove it? Even if he be a great man he may be called mean.

sa: क्षेपणीयैस्तथाप्यन्ये सात्वतस्य वधैषिणः। चोदितास्तव पुत्रेण सर्वतो रुरुधुर्दिशः॥
en: They obstructed all the points of the compass, urged as they were by your son. Then as they rushed desirous of fighting with their stones.

sa: किमग्नौ निपताम्यद्य आहोस्विद्वडवामुखे। शरीरमिह सत्त्वानां दद्मि सागरवासिनाम्॥
en: I shall jump into this flame or into a submarine fire, or I shall resign my mortal frame to the animals that infest the ocean.

sa: वहन्ति वर्षन्ति नदन्ति भान्ति ध्यायन्ति नृत्यन्ति समाश्वसन्ति। नद्यो घना मत्तगजा वनान्ताः प्रियाविहीनाः शिखिनः प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: The rivers are flowing by; the clouds are discharging waters; the infuriated elephants are emitting terrible roars; the forest-lands are growing more charming; persons, separated from their wives, are growing more anxious; the peacocks are dancing with delight and the monkeys are greatly comforted for Sugrīva's attaining to the kingdom.

sa: अपरस्मिन्नथोद्देशे कर्णं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्। द्वादशादित्यसहितं ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: In an ther place, the delighter of the Kuru saw Karna, that foremost one among all holders of weapons, resembling a dozen Suns in splendour.

sa: दातुं च तावदिच्छामि स्वर्गतस्य महीपतेः। और्ध्वदेहनिमित्तार्थमवतीर्योदकं नदीम्॥
en: Having crossed the stream, I am anxious to offer its water to the monarch, who has gone to heaven in behalf of his spiritual body.

sa: तं वै चतसृभिः स्त्रीभिरन्वितं पाण्डुनन्दनः। अदाहयच्चदनैश्च गन्धैरुच्चावचैरपि।॥
en: The son of Pandu burnt the body of his uncle together with those four wives of his, using various kinds of scents and perfumed wood.

sa: स गत्वा भ्रातरं शङ्खमार्तरूपोऽब्रवीदिदम्। धृतदण्डस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्भवांस्तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Returning to his brother Shankha, Likhita, in great agony said,-'You should now pardon this wretched man who has been duly punished (for what he did)'.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिहुँकारेणाभिभय॑ ताम्। स्वस्ति राघवयोरस्तु जयं चैवाभ्यभाषत॥
en: And thereat the Brahmarsi, Visvāmitra, uttering a roar, upbraided her, and said, Svasti!* May victory attend the descendants of Raghu! *A particle of benediction, indeclinable.

sa: विदुरश्चैव भीष्मश्च द्रोणश्च सहबाह्निकः। श्रेयः समर्था विज्ञातुमुच्यमानास्त्वयानघ॥
en: Vidura, Bhishma and Drona with Bahlika are capable of understanding yourself and of speaking words of wisdom of wisdom which beneficial at the same time.

sa: तथा प्रतिषिद्धो भैक्ष्यं नाश्नाति न चान्यच्चरति पयो न पिबति। फेनं नोपयुङ्क्ते स कदा चिदरण्ये क्षुधार्तोऽर्कपत्राण्यभक्षयत्॥ तैरर्कपत्रैक्षितैः क्षारतिक्तकटुरूक्षैस्तीक्ष्णविपाकैश्चक्षुष्युपहतोऽन्धो बभूव। ततः सोऽन्धोऽपि चङ्कम्यमाण: कूपे पपात॥
en: Thus prevented by his preceptor (from supporting himself,) he did not feed on alms, he did not drink the milk, or taste the froth, he had thus nothing to eat. One day being very much oppressed by hunger he ate the leaves of Arka tree in a forest. His eyes were affected by the pungent, acrimonious, crude and saline qualities of the leaves and he became blind. When he was thus walking about feeling his way he fell into a deep well.

sa: संदिश्य रामं नृपतिः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने। पुरोहितं समाहूय वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having given his directions to Rāma as to his in coming installation on the morrow, the king, summoning his priest, Vasiştha spoke to him, saying.

sa: ते समाश्वासयामासुराशीर्भिश्चाप्यपूजयन्। रक्षोघ्नांश्च तथा मन्त्राओपुश्चक्रुश्च ते क्रियाः॥
en: They comforted and consoled him and they honoured him with blessings. They uttered mantras capable of destroying Rakshasas and they also performed (some) religious rites.

sa: त्यांक ते समासाद्य पृतनास्वनिवर्तिनम्॥ वहवो लघुहस्ताश्च शरवधैरवाकिरन्।
en: Then thosc Yavanas endued with great lightness of hunds obtaining in their midst the unretreating Satyaki, began to cover him with mighty showers of arrows.

sa: आर्तिराते प्रिये प्रीतिरेतावन्मित्रलक्षणम्। विपरीतं तु बोद्धव्यमरिलक्षणमेव तत्॥
en: Lamenting in times of sorrow and rejoicing in times of joy are the marks of a friend, Contrary actions from the indications of an enemy.

sa: अथवा कुशलाः केचिदुपायनिपुणा नराः। इतरेतरतः पार्थान् भेदयन्त्वनुरागतः॥
en: O let some clever men, full of resources, sow the seed of disunion among the sons of Pritha and make them jealous of one another.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ संमतौ रथसत्तमौ। कृतिनौ समरे तात दृढवीर्यपराक्रमौ॥
en: In my opinion Vindu and Anuvindu, the princes of Avanti, accomplished in battle and of firm strength and prowess are two of the best Rathas.

sa: तामवेक्ष्य तु कौन्तेयो विवर्णवदनां कृशाम्। अङ्कमानीयधर्मात्मा पर्यदेवयदातुरः॥
en: Seeing her weak and also seeing her pale face, the high-souled son of Kunti, taking her up on his lap, began to lament (in grief).

sa: अदेशकाले यद् दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते। श्रऊसत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत् तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama gift is that which is given without respect and with contempt to an unworthy object in an improper place and at an improper time.

sa: स विचर्मा महाराज खङ्गपाणिरुपाद्रवत्। कृपस्य वशमापन्नो मृत्योरास्यमिवातुरः॥
en: Deprived of his shield, O monarch and brought under the influence of Kripa, he, with his sword, advanced like a sick man advancing towards death.

sa: भरतोऽपि तथैवोष्य संवत्सरमतोऽधिकम्। अयोध्यां पुनरागम्य रामपादावुपास्त सः॥
en: And Bharata, according to his desire, having spent more than a year in the city of Candrakāntă, came back to Ayodhyā and saluted Rama's feet.

sa: तांस्तानन्यान् महेष्वासान् साश्वान् सरथकूबरान्। अर्दयामास विशिखैरुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरान्॥
en: And he assailed all the other great bowmen with their horses and cars and elephants with many arrows like hunters assailing elephants with burning rods.

sa: उत्पपाताग्निसंकाशं हालाहलमहाविषम्। तेन दग्धं जगत् सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्॥
en: And thereat there came out powerful poison like to fire; and in consequence the entire universe with celestials, and Asuras, and men, began to burm.

sa: देवा देवानिजघ्नुस्ते राक्षसान्राक्षसास्तथा। संमूढास्तमसा छन्ना व्यद्रवनपरे तथा॥
en: Being enveloped with darkness and having their senses bewildered the celestials killed their own kith and the Rākṣasas their own men, and others fled away.

sa: उच्चावचांस्तथा भक्ष्यान् विप्रेभ्यो विप्रदाय सः। नीलवासास्तदागच्छच्छङ्घतीर्थं महायशाः॥
en: Having distributed also many sorts of rich food amongst the Brahmanas, that illustrious one, clad in blue robes, then went to the tirtha called Shankha.

sa: आच्छाद्य स्थपन्थानमुत्क्रोशन्तो महारथाः। आवृत्य सर्वतस्ते मां शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्।॥
en: Those mighty car-warriors obstructing the course of the car and uttering loud yells and surrounding me on all sides, enveloped me with downpours of arrows.

sa: शुक्लाभिजनसम्पन्नाः सर्वे सुप्रियदर्शनाः॥ मिथुनानि च जायन्ते स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसोपमाः।
en: All are of pure birth and all are exceedingly handsome. Husband and wife are born there and women there are like the Apsaras in beauty.

sa: मिषतां सर्वयोधानां ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः। समन्ततोऽवकृष्यन्त कामाच्चान्याः प्रवव्रजुः॥
en: Before the eyes of all the warriors, many foremost of ladies were dragged away, while others went away with the robbers of their own accord.

sa: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत् सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्। सर्वतःश्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: His hands and feet are everywhere. His cyes, head, and face are everywhere. His ears are everywhere in the universe. He exists Occupying all things.

sa: धनञ्जयस्तु दैवं तन्मनसाऽचिन्तयत् प्रभुः। दुःखशोकसमाविष्टो निःश्वासपरमोऽभवत्॥ अस्त्राणां च प्रणाशेन बाहुवीर्यस्य संक्षयात्। धनुषश्चाविधेयत्वाच्छराणां संक्षयेण च॥
en: The powerful Dhananjaya considered it all as the work of destiny. Filled with sorrow he breathed heavy sights, at the thought of the non-appearance of his (celestial) weapons, the loss of the might of his arms, the refusal of his bow to obey him; and the exhaustion of his arrows.

sa: गाण्डीवाद्धि तदा संख्ये यथा भ्रमरपक्तयः। निष्पतन्ति महाबाणास्तन्मातलिरपूजयत्॥
en: And the fact that on the battle field mighty arrows like (thick flights of black bees), were discharged from the Gandiva, was admired by Matali.

sa: अश्वयुक्तै रथैश्चापि गोखरोष्ट्रयुतैरपि। स्त्रियस्ता वृष्णिवीराणां रुदत्यः शोककर्शिताः॥
en: The windows of the Vrishni heroes wailing aloud, followed the great son of Pandu, viz., Dhananjaya, on cars drawn by bullocks and mules and camels.

sa: अस्मिन्द्वापरसंख्याने तपो वैश्यान्समाविशत्। त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्क्रमाद्वै तप आविशत्॥
en: And in Yuga named Dvāpara the Vaisyas engaged in devout penances. In this wise in three ages the three Varnas gradually engaged in ascetic performances.

sa: सोऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसंज्ञो विचेतनः। कालं तत्रावसत्कंचिद्वेष्टमान इवोरगः॥
en: Being at his wit's end he repaired to the other side of the Lokāloka mountain and remained there for some time like a coiled serpent.

sa: सहदेवस्ततः क्रुद्धः शरमुद्गृह्य वीर्यवान्। पद्रराजमभिप्रेक्ष्य प्रेषयामास भारत।॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Sahadeva, inflamed with wrath, grasping a dare, rushed at the ruler of Madras and then hurled it at him, O Bharata.

sa: तस्य ज्याविप्रमुक्तास्ते खराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। शरीरं विधमिष्यन्ति गङ्गाकूलमिवोर्मयः।७।।
en: The shafts decorated with gold shot by the bow-string of Rāghava, shall pierce their bodies, as the waves of the Ganga (beat against) her banks.

sa: विभीषयन्निव जगत् पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तत। नामृष्यत पुरा योऽसौ स्वबाहुबलगर्वितः॥
en: Came to the Pandavas as if terrifying the earth. The hero, proud of the strength of his own arms, could not pass, in silence before,

sa: एकान्तविजयस्त्वेव श्रूयते फाल्गुनस्य ह। त्रयस्त्रिंशत् समाहूय खाण्डवेऽग्निमतर्पयत्॥
en: But the rumour is that Falguna (when fighting) has but one result-victory; thirty three years ago (he) having invited the god of fire gratified him.

sa: विदुलोवाच अर्थतस्यामवस्थायां पौरुषं हातुमिच्छसि। निहीनसेवितं मागं गमिष्यस्यचिरादिव॥
en: Vidula said If under these circumstances you desire to abandon manliness, you will soon be following the path followed by the mean and the low.

sa: सर्वा दिशश्चान्यपतद् बीभत्सुरपराजितः। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयो लब्धलक्षो महाबलः॥
en: Bibhatsu, never defeated in battle-the highly powerful son of Kunti, adorned with a diadem and having sure aim, covered all the quarters with his arrows.

sa: समर्थमेकं पर्याप्तं कौरवाणां विनिग्रहे। पुरस्तादुपयातानां कौरवाणां युयुत्सताम्॥
en: Alone you are quite capable of effecting the overthrow of the Kauravas. To meet the Kauravas, desirous of war and standing in front of us.

sa: कर्णो वैकर्तनश्चैव शकुनिश्च महाबलः। भीष्मद्रोणकृपाश्चैव तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि॥
en: What did the son of the sun, Karna and the powerful Shakuni and Bhishma, Drona and Kripa do. You should narrate all this to me.

sa: स सायकमयैर्जालैः सर्वतस्तान् महारथान्। प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा नीहारेणेव पर्वतान्॥
en: That one of incomparable energy covered, on all sides, all those mighty car-warriors with a net-work of arrows as the mountains are covered with dews.

sa: कौसल्यामातरित्येवमाभाष्य मधुरं वचः। इदमित्याह रत्नानामाकरैः शतशो वृतः॥
en: And addressing him in such sweet words as "O son of Kausalya," (the Ocean) surrounded by hundreds of mines of gems thus spoke to Rama).

sa: तं स रक्षोमहामात्रमापतन्तं सपत्निजत्। प्रतिजग्राह हनुमांस्तरसा पवनात्मजः॥
en: Then the son of Pavana, Hanuman, the vanquisher of his foes, quickly seized that leader of the Rakshasas who was advancing (against the monkey host).

sa: चतुर्दशमिदं वर्ष यन्नापश्यमरिंदम। पुत्रादिभिः परियूनां द्रौपदी सत्यवादिनीम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the one whom I have not seen for these fourteen years, that Draupadi, truthful of speech, is anxious for her children.

sa: अतिष्ठदेकपादेन सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्। वायुभक्षो दशग्रीवः पञ्चाग्निः सुसमाहितः॥
en: Subsisting on air only surrounded by five sacred fires and engaged in meditation the tenheaded Ravana remained standing on one leg for a thousand years.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तामादायार्जनुस्तूर्णं द्रौपदीं गजराडिव। सम्प्राप्य नगराभ्याशमवतारयदर्जुनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Arjuna, like the leader of elephants, quickly took up Draupadi (Drupada's daughter) and on reaching the skirts of the forest let her down.

sa: अव्याधिजं कटुकं शीर्षरोगि यशोमुषं पापफलोदयं वा। सतां पेयं यनन पिबन्त्यसन्तो मन्युं महाराज पिब प्रशाम्य॥
en: Wrath is a bitter remedy for evils, it causes malady in the head, destroys fame and is a source of sinful acts. It ought to be controlled by a good man and those that do not control it are bad men. O great king, control your wrath. Incline to peace.

sa: अकृतात्मानमासाद्य राजानमनये रतम्। विनश्यन्त्यनयाविष्टा देशाश्च नगराणि च॥
en: (Those) countries and cities whose kings are addicted to immoral acts and are incapable of controlling their minds, are themselves covered with sin and destroyed.

sa: पुष्पितस्येव फेनेन पर्यन्तमनुवेष्टितम्। पिबन्तो निवसन्त्यत्र फेनपा मुनिसत्तमाः॥
en: The limit of the sea is surrounded by foam which looks like flowers and here live those best among Munis-the drinkers of foam, drinking it.

sa: तेषां मध्ये महर्षीणां शृण्वतामनुशोचताम्। मार्कण्डेयमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: Amongst those great ascetics who were expressing their sorrow on hearing of the incident) the descendant of Pandu, addressing Markandeya, gave vent to the following.

sa: यः पञ्चाभ्यन्तराञ्छत्रूनविजित्य मनोमयान्। जिगीषति रिपूनन्यान् रिपवोऽभिभवन्ति तम्॥
en: He, who without subjugating the five enemies within that have their origin in the mind, desires to subdue other enemies, is vanquished by these enemies.

sa: रौद्रः क्षत्रियधर्मोऽयं गुरुणा यदयुध्यता इत्यब्रुवढानास्तत्र संग्रामशिरसि स्थिताः॥
en: Surely the duty of a Kshatriya is very hard, since he fights with his preceptor.” Thus did the people, stationed in the battle field, say.

sa: अनेकयुगवर्षायुर्निहत्य नरकं मृधे। नीत्वा कन्यासहस्राणि उपयेमे यथाविधि॥
en: Slaying in battle Naraka who had lived for many thousands of years he brought away his thousand daughters and married them with the usual rites.

sa: तदनीकं महद् दृष्ट्वा गजाश्वरथसंकुलम्। कर्णदुर्योधनकृपैर्गुप्तं शान्तनवेन च॥
en: Which destroyed the vision of creatures and touched the sky, O best of Kurus. Then beholding that huge army abounding in elephants, horses and chariots.

sa: रथेनाभिपपाताथ दशग्रीवं रुषान्वितः। हाहाकृतानि भूतानि रावणे समभिद्रुते॥
en: And riding on that car rushed in great wrath against the ten-necked. (And) when Ravana flew (towards Rama) all the creatures began to wail loudly.

sa: कृतस्य कर्मणस्तत्र भुज्यते यत् फलं दिवि। न चान्यत् क्रियते कर्म मूलच्छेदेन भुज्यते॥ सोऽत्र दोषो मम मतस्तस्यान्ते पतनं च यत्। सुखव्याप्तमनस्कानां पतनं यच्च मुद्गल॥
en: O Mudgala, in the celestial region a person, while enjoying the fruits of acts he had already performed, cannot perform any other new acts. He must enjoy the fruits of the former life till they are completely exhausted and besides he is liable to fall after he has entirely exhausted his merit, these are in my opinion the disadvantages of heaven. The fall of persons whose minds have been once steeped in happiness must be called a great draw back (of heaven).

sa: उभौ विश्रुतकर्माणावुभौ तीव्रपराक्रमौ। उभौ सदृशकर्माणावुभौ युधि सुदुर्जयौ॥
en: Both warriors are famous for their excellent deeds through the world. Both are aggressively valorous. Both equally chivalours and tough to defeat in the battle.

sa: श्वोभूते भर्तृमरणे सावित्र्या भरतर्षभ। दुःखान्वितायास्तिष्ठन्त्याः सा रात्रिर्व्यत्यवर्तत॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, thinking that her husband would die tomorrow, Savitri, stricken with grief and observing fasts, passed the night in great sorrow.

sa: ततोऽभ्यधावतां वीरावुभौ भीमधनंजयौ। हताश्वं सैन्धवं भीतमेकं व्याकुलचेतसम्॥
en: Then the two heroes Bhima and Arjuna rushed towards the terror-stricken king of Sindhu whose horses had been killed and who was perplexed in mind.

sa: शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्तं यदा द्रक्ष्यसि केशवम्। पर्याददानं चास्त्राणि भीमधन्वानमर्जुनम्॥
en: When you will see Keshava with the conch, the disc and the mace in his hand and Arjuna with that terrific-looking bow taking up weapons.

sa: तथा समभवच्चापि यदुवाच विभीषणः। क्षणेनातीन्द्रियाण्येषां चढूंष्यासन् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: (Thereupon) what Vibhishana had said, (exactly) came about. And, O Yudhishthira, soon their eyes became capable of perceiving objects beyond the reach of the senses.

sa: याज्ञसेनीमथो यत्र सिन्धुराजोऽपकृष्टवान्। तत्रैषामभवद् द्वीपः कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः॥
en: That son of Kunti, Vrikodara, who became the means of rescue at the time when Sindhuraja was gratifying his lust on the daughter of Yajnasena.

sa: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभिषैिरेव समन्वितः। त्वयोच्यमानः श्रेयोऽपि संरम्भान्न ग्रहीष्यति॥
en: He is possessed with these and many other vices; out of vanity he will not accept your advice though that is distinctly for his good.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच उभयमेव तत्रोपयुज्यते फलं धर्मस्यैवेतरस्य च॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said The fruits of virtue and also those of the other (complete inaction), both of these are of use that respect (for obtaining emancipation).

sa: स्वयं निष्फलमालक्ष्य संविधत्स्व विशाम्पते। सहायभूता भरतास्तवैव स्युर्जनेश्वरः॥
en: Act for yourself after a consideration of the consequences, O lord of the universe and let the Bharatas be your allies O lord of men.

sa: लोपामुद्रा तथा भीरु वयोरूपसमन्विता। अगस्तिमन्वयाद्धित्वा कामान् सर्वानमानुषान्॥
en: O excellent one, Lopamudra also, endued with youth and beauty, followed her lord Agastya, renouncing all objects of enjoyments hardly to be attained by men.

sa: श्रुत्वा गृहीतं वार्ष्णेयं पाण्डवा हतचेतसः। निरुत्साहा भविष्यन्ति भग्नदंष्ट्रा इवोरगाः॥
en: Hearing that the scion of the Vrishni race has been captured, the sons of Pandu will lose heart and will became deprived of their energy like serpents whose fangs have been broken.

sa: अष्टौ तान्यव्रतनानि आपो मूलं फलं पयः। हविर्ब्रह्मणकाम्या च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम्॥
en: These eight do not lead to the nonobservance of a vow-water, roots, fruits, milk, clarified butter, acts done at the desire of a Brahmana or the commands of an elder and medicine.

sa: भोजराजस्य वृद्धस्य दुराचारो ह्यनात्मवान्। जीवतः पितुरैश्वर्यं हृत्वा मृत्युवशं गतः॥
en: During the life time of the old king of Bhoja, his son, of wicked behaviour and a slave to his passions, having usurped the throne of his father subjected himself to death.

sa: एवमेवोपकर्तृणां प्रायशो लक्षयामहे। इच्छान्ति बहुलं सन्तः प्रतिकर्तुं महत् प्रियम्॥
en: The same is also seen in benefactors generally. Good men always have a great inclination to repay the great good done them and to do what is highly agreeable to their benefactors.

sa: व्यात्तास्यः सस्तकायश्च विचेता विह्वलः खगः। मुमोच पत्राणि तदा गुरुभारप्रपीडितः॥
en: Writhing under that heavy load that wanderer of the sky gasped for breath, was stupefied, lost his senses and his energies were all dried up and he was stripped off his feathers.

sa: कः शूलं तीक्ष्णमासाद्य सर्वगात्रैनिषेवते। कः शिरसस्यग्निमाघाय विश्वस्तः स्वपते सुखम्॥
en: Who is he that having got a sharp spear has rubbed it all over his body? Who is he that is sleeping in peace and security, keeping a fire near his head?

sa: यः कल्याणगुणाज्ञातीन् मोहाल्लोभाद् दिदृक्षते। सोऽजितात्माजितक्रोधो न चिरं तिष्ठति श्रियम्॥
en: A deserving man and bears him malice, has been called the vilest of men, and he who desires to see a cousin endued with blessed virtue with eyes of lost of ignorance.

sa: प्रादुरास्तां तथा दो• संकर्षणधनंजयौ। दक्षिणेऽथार्जुनो धन्वी हली रामश्च सव्यतः॥
en: Issued out thence. In the same way from his two eyes sprang up Sankarshana and Dhananjaya. In his right stood Arjuna the bowman and in his left stood Rama with the plough.

sa: सोऽभिषिक्तः कपिश्रेष्ठं सुग्रीवं ससुहृज्जनम्। विभीषणं च पौलस्त्यमन्वजानाद् गृहान् प्रति॥
en: Being installed (on the throne) Rama gave his permission to that foremost of monkeys, Sugriva together with his friends and also to Vibhishana, the son of Pulastya to return to their homes.

sa: सत्यात् सत्यं तु गोविन्दस्तस्मात् सत्योऽपि नामतः। विष्णुर्विक्रमणाद् देवो जयनाज्जिष्णुरुच्यते॥
en: The name of Govinda is truth; because he is Truth of truths. Owing to his strength he is called Vishnu; and owing to his victory over the gods he is called Jishnu.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क्रोधः सुदुर्जयः शत्रुर्लोभो व्याधिरनन्तकः। सर्वभूतहितः साधुरसाधुर्निर्दयः स्मृतः॥
en: Yudhishthira replied Anger is the most invincible enemy. Covetousness is the incurable disease. He who is friendly to all creatures is honest. And he that is cruel is spoken of as dishonest.

sa: तदनेनैव दोषेण क्षीणं येनासि पातितः। अभिमानेन राजेन्द्र विक्कृतः स्वर्गवासिभिः॥
en: Was destroyed by this defect owing to which you were hurled down: O chief among kings, owing to your vanity you cared very little and held in contempt the denizens of heaven.

sa: न चातिष्ठत् पितुः शास्त्रे बलदर्पविमोहितः। अवमेने च पितरं भ्रातूंश्चाप्यपराजितः॥
en: He did not act up to the instructions of his father being stupified by the pride of his strength; and having never sustained a defeat he insulted his father and his brothers.

sa: नादैविकमहं मन्ये यत्र पार्थो धनंजयः। भीमधन्वा महाबाहुरास्ते छन्न इवानलः॥
en: As the mighty-armed and terrible bowman Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha, lives here, like a fire covered over by ashes, then must I think that all these actions are due to Destiny.

sa: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रास्त्रिदशा मुमुचुः पावकार्चिषः। तस्य ब्रह्मा ललाटस्थो रुद्रो वक्षसि चाभवत्॥
en: And from his body issued forth gods of the measures of the thumb but having the rays of fire and Brahma was found to be his brow and Rudra on his breast.

sa: गाण्डीवोत्थं दहेताजौ पुत्राणां मम वाहिनीम्। अपि सारथ्यघोषेण भयार्ता सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: And coming out of the Gandiva bow and burning up the four elements of the army of my sons. (I see) also that struck with fear from the sound of Savyasachin's chariot.

sa: मिथ्योपचरिता ह्येते वर्तमाना ह्यनु प्रिये। अहितत्वाय कल्पन्ते दोषा भरतसत्तम॥
en: These sons of Pandu, though treacherously dealt with by you, now desire only what is good for you who cherish wicked intentions, O you best among the Bharatas, for your own injury.

sa: यक्ष उवाच इन्द्रियार्थाननुभवन् बुद्धिमॉल्लोकपूजितः। सम्मतः सर्वभूतानामुच्छ्वसन् को न जीवति॥
en: The Yaksha said : Is there any person, endowed with intelligence, worshipped by the world, respected by all the creatures, who, though enjoying the objects of senses and breathing, is not alive?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच या सा बाल्यात् प्रभृत्यस्मान् पर्यवर्धयताबला। उपवासतप:शीला सदा स्वस्त्ययने रता॥ देवतातिथिपूजासु गुरुशुश्रूषणे रता। वत्सला प्रियपुत्रा च प्रियास्माकं जनार्दन॥ सुयोधनभयाद् या नोऽत्रायतामित्रकर्शन। महतो मृत्युसम्बाधादुद्धरेनौरिवार्णवात्॥ अस्मत्कृते च सततं यया दुःखानि माधव। अनुभूतान्यदुःखार्हाः तां स्म पृच्छेरनामयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said The lady, who had reared us from our infancy, with whom fasts and devotion are habits and who is ever attached to propitiatory rites and ceremonics, who is attached to the worship of the Gods and the guest and the due service of her elder, who is fond of her sons and bearing great affection for them and who, OJanardana, are dear to us, who has saved us from the wickedness of Suyodhana, O grinder of enemies, like a boat (saving the ship wracked) from the great and terrific death in the sea and by whom troubles have often been encountered, O Madhava, for our sake, though she herself is not desiring it, should be interrogated regarding her welfare.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रायोपविष्टं राजानं दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। उवाच सान्त्वयन् राजञ्छकुनिः सौबलस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, seeing Duryodhana who is always incapable of putting up with an insult, seated with the determination of dying by starvation, the son of Subala, Shakuni, spoke thus.

sa: धौम्य उवाच सर्वैर्गुणैरुपेतस्ते यथा पुत्रो जनप्रियः। दीर्घायुर्लक्षणोपेतस्तथा जीवति सत्यवान्॥
en: Dhaumya said : Your son Satyavana is surely alive in as much as he is endued with all the noble qualities, beloved by all and bears signs indicative of a long life.

sa: तयोश्चैतदवज्ञानं यत् सा कृष्णा समागता। दुःशासनश्च यद् भीमं कटुकान्यभ्यभाषत॥
en: The insult that was offered to Krishna, when she was made to enter the council hall and the harsh and frightful words that Dushasana addressed to her, were also insulting to them,

sa: येन धर्मसुते दृष्टा न सा श्रीरुपमर्षिता। यच्चाप्यपश्यतोपायं धर्मिष्ठं मधुसूदन॥
en: They robbed us (of our kingdom) by the cruel and sinful means of a deceitful game at dice. Where is the wielder of the bow, who though born in a Kshatriya family.

sa: योऽन्यथा सन्तमात्मानमन्यथा प्रतिपद्यते। किं तेन न कृतं पापं चौरेणात्मापहारिणा॥
en: He who considers that heaven is attainable by actions alone and so employs himself in action, what sin is not committed by that thief who robs the soul (of its true attributes)?

sa: एषोऽस्य पुत्रोऽभिमतः पुष्करः पुष्करेक्षणः। रुपवान् दर्शनीयश्च सोमपुत्र्या वृतः पतिः॥
en: This is his dear son, Pushkara of eyes like lotus leaves. He is endued with beauty, is worth looking at and has been selected by the daughter of Soma as her husband.

sa: उदयन् नित्यशश्चात्र चन्द्रमा रश्मिबाहुभिः। अमृतं स्पृश्य संस्पर्शात् संजीवयति देहिनः॥
en: For the moon, rising in these regions every night, by her beams which are her arms as it were, brings nectar in contact with them; and from that are the creatures revived.

sa: त्वया धर्मार्थयुक्तं चेदुक्तं शिवमनामयम्। हितं नादास्यते बालो दिष्टस्य वशमेष्यति॥
en: with eyes If the boy does not accept your beneficial words conducive both to morality and worldly good and calculated to assure their weal; then shall he be subject to his fate,

sa: तं देवमब्रवीद् भीता बन्धूनां राजसत्तम। व्रीडाविह्वलया वाचा शापत्रस्ता विशाम्पते॥
en: Oforemost of kings, O lord of the world, afraid of the censure of her friends and afflicted with the fear of curse, she spoke to that deity these words tremulous with bashfulness.

sa: तपसः संविभागेन भवन्तमपि योक्ष्यते। स्वेन राजर्षितपसा पूर्णं त्वां पूरयिष्यति॥
en: With a portion of the fruit of his austerities will you also be rewarded for with his own devotion will he enrich you, O royal Rishi, who are rich in earthly treasures.

sa: तदत्र पुम्डरीकाक्ष विधत्स्व यदभीप्सितम्। यथा कार्येन वार्ष्णेय क्षत्रं स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O you of lotus-eyes, manage things in such a way in this case that we may gain our endthat united together the Kshatriyas go to heaven, O you of the Vrishni race.

sa: प्रतिप्रास्थानिकं कर्म सात्यकिस्तु करिष्यति। दीक्षितो धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्र पली चास्य महाचमूः॥
en: Satyaki will do the duties of the chief assistant to the head priest; the son of Dhritarashtra will be the performer and his large army will take the place of his wife.

sa: स्तथा प्रमनीत यथा न मुच्येत्। तमब्रवीच्छान्तनवः प्रहस्य क्व ते गता बुद्धिरभूत् क्व वीर्यम्॥ रुत्सृज्य बाणांश्च धनुर्विचित्रम्॥
en: "O Grandfather! How had he escaped from your hands? Churn him so badly as he could not escape." Bhishma, the son of Shantanu toughed and replied Duryodhana "O king! Where had your wit gone when you fell down unconscious here and your bow and arrows left aside? Tell me that where was your valour at that time?

sa: सुमहत्यपराधेऽपि क्षान्ति: कार्या द्विजातिभिः। यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं पूजा चाह्या द्विजोत्तम॥
en: The twice-born ones again ought to pardon even a very serious offence; and the best of Brahmanas should accept that worship which is offered to the best of one's ability and exertion.

sa: महावनेष्वबोध्यन्त श्वापदानां रुतेन च। ह्रीमान् सत्यधृतिर्दान्तो भूतानामनुकम्पिता॥ कामद्वेषो वशे कृत्वा सतां वानुवर्तते। अम्बरीषस्य मान्धातुर्ययातेर्नहुषस्य च॥ भरतस्य दिलीपस्य शिबेरौशीनरस्य च। राजर्षीणां पुराणानां धुरं धत्ते दुरुद्वहाम्॥ शीलवृत्तोपसम्पन्नो धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंगरः। राजा सर्वगुणोपेतस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि यो भवेत्॥ अजातशत्रुर्धर्मात्मा शुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः। श्रेष्ठः कुरुषु सर्वेषु धर्मतः श्रुतवृत्ततः। प्रियदशों दीर्घभुजः कथं कृष्ण युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: In the great forest be awakened at the roar of animals? The one endowed with modesty, truth, patience, self-control and kindness to animals and who bringing his desire and malice under control walks on the path followed by the good, he was capable of bearing the heavy burden of the ancient sages of royal descentnamely Amvarisha, Mandhatta, Yayati, Nahusha, Bharata, Dilipa, Shibi, the son of Ushanara; he who followed good habits of life and conversant with virtue, of true prowess, he who endued with all the virtuous uses, the king of all the three worlds, viz., the virtuous-souled Ajatashatru of a pious complexion and having a complexion like that of gold, chief among the Kurus and among all in respect of virtue and those who shape their habits of life to the ways indicated in the holy book

sa: अपि ह्येतद् दरिद्राणां व्यलीकस्थानमुत्तमम्। न मृषाभिहितं राज्ञां मनुष्येषु प्रकाशयेत्॥
en: No one should give publicity to what transpires in the very presence of the king because even for those who are very favourite it is looked upon as the height of impertinence.

sa: वासुदेवसहायस्य गर्जतः सानुजस्य ते। मध्ये कुरूणां कौन्तेय तस्य कालोऽयमागतः॥
en: Proceeding from yourself and your younger brothers having Vasudeva for your ally, with a roar in the midst of the Kurus. O son of Kunti, the time for that has now come.

sa: अभिज्ञो दूतवाक्यानां यथोक्तं ब्रूवतो मम। दुर्योधनसमादेशं श्रुत्वा न क्रोद्भुमर्हसि॥
en: You very well know the nature of the words of envoys; therefore it is not proper that you should be angry with me who will only speak what Duryodhana has instructed me.

sa: वागीशाने भगवति व्यासे व्यभ्रनभःप्रभे। गते मतिमतां श्रेष्ठे समाश्वास्य युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Upon the disappearance of that eloquent speaker, that foremost of all intelligent beings, viz., the holy Vyasa whose colour was like that of the sky overspread with clouds, Yudhishthira having obtained consolation.

sa: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिचाह्यमतीन्द्रियम्। वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः॥
en: In which one experiences that infinite felicity which is beyond the sphere of the senses, and which Buddhi (understanding) can only grasp, and adhering to which one never Swerve from the truth.

sa: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः। अधश्च मूलान्यनुसंततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके॥
en: Its branches which are enlarged by the qualities stretched upwards and downwards; its sprouts are the objects of senses. Its roots, leading to actions, are extended downward to this world of men.

sa: वेदनार्तशरीरस्य प्रयच्छापो ममार्जुन। त्वं हि शक्तो महेष्वास दातुमापो यथाविधि॥
en: Afflicted as my body is with extreme pain, give me water, O Arjuna, to drink. It is you alone, O mighty bowman, that are capable of supplying me with proper drink now."

sa: संवर्धता गोपकुले बालेनैव महात्मना। विख्यापितं बलं बाहोस्त्रिषु लोकेषु संजय॥
en: While he was being reared in the family of the cowherds, the illustrious one, even in his early years, made the might of his arms, O Sanjaya, known to the three worlds.

sa: येऽभवन्नग्रतः क्रुद्धा राक्षसस्य पुरःसराः। विमुखांश्चैव तान् दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिचापच्युतैः शरैः॥
en: Who were stationed in the front of in Ghatotkacha; beholding his own troops turn faces away from the field of battle, in consequence of the shafts shot from the bow of Drona,

sa: धनेश्वरस्यानुचरों वरदोऽस्मि नृपात्मजे। अदेयमपि दास्यामि ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्॥
en: “O daughter of the king, I am an attendant of the god of wealth, and I can grant boons. I will bestow even what is unbestowable. So tell me what you desire."

sa: महारथाशरैर्विद्ध्वा वारयित्वा च मारिष।॥ विरथं सैन्धवं चक्रे सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः।
en: In as much as piercing all those mighty carwarriors with arrows and resisting them, he deprived, O sire, the ruler of the Sindhus, of his car, before the eyes of all on-lookers.

sa: अदर्शयद् वासुदेवो हययाने परं बलम्। मोघान् कुर्वशरांस्तस्य मण्डलानि निदर्शयन्॥
en: Then the son of Vasudeva displayed superior skill in the management of horses in as much as he baffled Bhishma's arrows by a swift whirling of the car in a circular motion.
